command.name: message
command.desc: Log a message.

use.val: (STATUS "Looking for someheader.h") #... do the checks, set checkSuccess with the result if(checkSuccess) message(STATUS "Looking for someheader.h - found") else() message(STATUS "Looking for someheader.h - not found") endif()

(CHECK_START "Finding my things") list(APPEND CMAKE_MESSAGE_INDENT " ") unset(missingComponents) message(CHECK_START "Finding partA") # ... do check, assume we find A message(CHECK_PASS "found") message(CHECK_START "Finding partB") # ... do check, assume we don't find B list(APPEND missingComponents B) message(CHECK_FAIL "not found") list(POP_BACK CMAKE_MESSAGE_INDENT) if(missingComponents) message(CHECK_FAIL "missing components: ${missingComponents}") else() message(CHECK_PASS "all components found") endif()

prop.name: <CONFIG>_OUTPUT_NAME
prop.desc: Old per-configuration target file base name. Use OUTPUT_NAME_<CONFIG> instead.

prop.desc: Postfix to append to the target file name for configuration <CONFIG>.

prop.name: ABSTRACT
prop.desc: Is this source file an abstract class.

prop.name: ADDITIONAL_CLEAN_FILES
prop.desc: A ;-list of files or directories that will be removed as a part of the global clean target. It can be used to specify files and directories that are generated as part of building the target or that are directly associated with the target in some way (e.g. created as a result of running the target).

prop.name: ADDITIONAL_MAKE_CLEAN_FILES
prop.desc: Additional files to remove during the clean stage.

prop.name: ADVANCED
prop.desc: True if entry should be hidden by default in GUIs.

prop.name: AIX_EXPORT_ALL_SYMBOLS
prop.desc: On AIX, CMake automatically exports all symbols from shared libraries, and from executables with the ENABLE_EXPORTS target property set. Explicitly disable this boolean property to suppress the behavior and export no symbols by default. In this case it is expected that the project will use other means to export some symbols.

prop.name: AIX_SHARED_LIBRARY_ARCHIVE
prop.desc: On AIX, enable or disable creation of a shared library archive for a SHARED library target:

prop.name: ALIASED_TARGET
prop.desc: Name of target aliased by this target.

prop.name: ALIAS_GLOBAL
prop.desc: Read-only property indicating of whether an ALIAS target is globally visible.

prop.name: ALLOW_DUPLICATE_CUSTOM_TARGETS
prop.desc: Allow duplicate custom targets to be created.

prop.name: ANDROID_ANT_ADDITIONAL_OPTIONS
prop.desc: Set the additional options for Android Ant build system. This is a string value containing all command line options for the Ant build. This property is initialized by the value of the CMAKE_ANDROID_ANT_ADDITIONAL_OPTIONS variable if it is set when a target is created.

prop.name: ANDROID_API
prop.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android with NVIDIA Nsight Tegra Visual Studio Edition, this property sets the Android target API version (e.g. 15). The version number must be a positive decimal integer. This property is initialized by the value of the CMAKE_ANDROID_API variable if it is set when a target is created.

prop.name: ANDROID_API_MIN
prop.desc: Set the Android MIN API version (e.g. 9). The version number must be a positive decimal integer. This property is initialized by the value of the CMAKE_ANDROID_API_MIN variable if it is set when a target is created. Native code builds using this API version.

prop.name: ANDROID_ARCH
prop.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android with NVIDIA Nsight Tegra Visual Studio Edition, this property sets the Android target architecture.

prop.name: ANDROID_ASSETS_DIRECTORIES
prop.desc: Set the Android assets directories to copy into the main assets folder before build. This a string property that contains the directory paths separated by semicolon. This property is initialized by the value of the CMAKE_ANDROID_ASSETS_DIRECTORIES variable if it is set when a target is created.

prop.name: ANDROID_GUI
prop.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android with NVIDIA Nsight Tegra Visual Studio Edition, this property specifies whether to build an executable as an application package on Android.

prop.name: ANDROID_JAR_DEPENDENCIES
prop.desc: Set the Android property that specifies JAR dependencies. This is a string value property. This property is initialized by the value of the CMAKE_ANDROID_JAR_DEPENDENCIES variable if it is set when a target is created.

prop.name: ANDROID_JAR_DIRECTORIES
prop.desc: Set the Android property that specifies directories to search for the JAR libraries.

prop.name: ANDROID_JAVA_SOURCE_DIR
prop.desc: Set the Android property that defines the Java source code root directories. This a string property that contains the directory paths separated by semicolon. This property is initialized by the value of the CMAKE_ANDROID_JAVA_SOURCE_DIR variable if it is set when a target is created.

prop.name: ANDROID_NATIVE_LIB_DEPENDENCIES
prop.desc: Set the Android property that specifies the .so dependencies. This is a string property.

prop.name: ANDROID_NATIVE_LIB_DIRECTORIES
prop.desc: Set the Android property that specifies directories to search for the .so libraries.

prop.name: ANDROID_PROCESS_MAX
prop.desc: Set the Android property that defines the maximum number of a parallel Android NDK compiler processes (e.g. 4). This property is initialized by the value of the CMAKE_ANDROID_PROCESS_MAX variable if it is set when a target is created.

prop.name: ANDROID_PROGUARD
prop.desc: When this property is set to true that enables the ProGuard tool to shrink, optimize, and obfuscate the code by removing unused code and renaming classes, fields, and methods with semantically obscure names. This property is initialized by the value of the CMAKE_ANDROID_PROGUARD variable if it is set when a target is created.

prop.name: ANDROID_PROGUARD_CONFIG_PATH
prop.desc: Set the Android property that specifies the location of the ProGuard config file. Leave empty to use the default one. This a string property that contains the path to ProGuard config file. This property is initialized by the value of the CMAKE_ANDROID_PROGUARD_CONFIG_PATH variable if it is set when a target is created.

prop.name: ANDROID_SECURE_PROPS_PATH
prop.desc: Set the Android property that states the location of the secure properties file. This is a string property that contains the file path. This property is initialized by the value of the CMAKE_ANDROID_SECURE_PROPS_PATH variable if it is set when a target is created.

prop.name: ANDROID_SKIP_ANT_STEP
prop.desc: Set the Android property that defines whether or not to skip the Ant build step. This is a boolean property initialized by the value of the CMAKE_ANDROID_SKIP_ANT_STEP variable if it is set when a target is created.

prop.name: ANDROID_STL_TYPE
prop.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android with NVIDIA Nsight Tegra Visual Studio Edition, this property specifies the type of STL support for the project. This is a string property that could set to the one of the following values:

prop.name: ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
prop.desc: Output directory in which to build ARCHIVE target files.

prop.name: ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: Per-configuration output directory for ARCHIVE target files.

prop.name: ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_NAME
prop.desc: Output name for ARCHIVE target files.

prop.name: ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_NAME_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: Per-configuration output name for ARCHIVE target files.

prop.name: ASM-ATT_CLANG_TIDY

prop.name: ASM-ATT_CLANG_TIDY_EXPORT_FIXES_DIR

prop.name: AUTOGEN_BETTER_GRAPH_MULTI_CONFIG
prop.desc: AUTOGEN_BETTER_GRAPH_MULTI_CONFIG is a boolean property that can be set on a target to have better dependency graph for multi-configuration generators. When this property is enabled, CMake will generate more per-config targets. Thus, the dependency graph will be more accurate for multi-configuration generators and some recompilations will be avoided.

prop.name: AUTOGEN_BUILD_DIR
prop.desc: Directory where AUTOMOC, AUTOUIC and AUTORCC generate files for the target.

prop.name: AUTOGEN_COMMAND_LINE_LENGTH_MAX
prop.desc: Command line length limit for autogen targets, i.e. moc or uic, that triggers the use of response files on Windows instead of passing all arguments to the command line.

prop.name: AUTOGEN_ORIGIN_DEPENDS
prop.desc: Switch for forwarding origin target dependencies to the corresponding <ORIGIN>_autogen target.

prop.name: AUTOGEN_PARALLEL
prop.desc: Number of parallel moc or uic processes to start when using AUTOMOC and AUTOUIC.

prop.name: AUTOGEN_SOURCE_GROUP
prop.desc: Name of the source_group() for AUTOMOC, AUTORCC and AUTOUIC generated files.

prop.name: AUTOGEN_TARGETS_FOLDER
prop.desc: Name of FOLDER for *_autogen targets that are added automatically by CMake for targets for which AUTOMOC is enabled.

prop.name: AUTOGEN_TARGET_DEPENDS
prop.desc: Additional target dependencies of the corresponding <ORIGIN>_autogen target.

prop.name: AUTOGEN_USE_SYSTEM_INCLUDE
prop.desc: AUTOGEN_USE_SYSTEM_INCLUDE is a boolean property that can be set on a target to indicate that the autogen target include directory should be added as a system include directory or normal include directory to the target.

prop.name: AUTOMOC
prop.desc: Should the target be processed with auto-moc (for Qt projects).

prop.name: AUTOMOC_COMPILER_PREDEFINES
prop.desc: Boolean value used by AUTOMOC to determine if the compiler pre definitions file moc_predefs.h should be generated.

prop.name: AUTOMOC_DEPEND_FILTERS
prop.desc: Filter definitions used by AUTOMOC to extract file names from a source file that are registered as additional dependencies for the moc file of the source file.

prop.name: AUTOMOC_EXECUTABLE
prop.desc: AUTOMOC_EXECUTABLE is file path pointing to the moc executable to use for AUTOMOC enabled files. Setting this property will make CMake skip the automatic detection of the moc binary as well as the sanity-tests normally run to ensure that the binary is available and working as expected.

prop.name: AUTOMOC_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES
prop.desc: Specifies zero or more include directories for AUTOMOC to pass explicitly to the Qt Meta‑Object Compiler (moc) instead of automatically discovering a target's include directories.

prop.name: AUTOMOC_MACRO_NAMES
prop.desc: A semicolon-separated list of macro names used by AUTOMOC to determine if a C++ file needs to be processed by moc.

prop.name: AUTOMOC_MOC_OPTIONS
prop.desc: Additional options for moc when using AUTOMOC

prop.name: AUTOMOC_PATH_PREFIX
prop.desc: When this property is ON, CMake will generate the -p path prefix option for moc on AUTOMOC enabled Qt targets.

prop.name: AUTOMOC_SOURCE_GROUP
prop.desc: Name of the source_group() for AUTOMOC generated files.

prop.name: AUTOMOC_TARGETS_FOLDER
prop.desc: Name of FOLDER for *_autogen targets that are added automatically by CMake for targets for which AUTOMOC is enabled.

prop.name: AUTORCC
prop.desc: Should the target be processed with auto-rcc (for Qt projects).

prop.name: AUTORCC_EXECUTABLE
prop.desc: AUTORCC_EXECUTABLE is file path pointing to the rcc executable to use for AUTORCC enabled files. Setting this property will make CMake skip the automatic detection of the rcc binary as well as the sanity-tests normally run to ensure that the binary is available and working as expected.

prop.name: AUTORCC_OPTIONS
prop.desc: Additional options for rcc when using AUTORCC

prop.name: AUTORCC_SOURCE_GROUP
prop.desc: Name of the source_group() for AUTORCC generated files.

prop.name: AUTOUIC
prop.desc: Should the target be processed with auto-uic (for Qt projects).

prop.name: AUTOUIC_EXECUTABLE
prop.desc: AUTOUIC_EXECUTABLE is file path pointing to the uic executable to use for AUTOUIC enabled files. Setting this property will make CMake skip the automatic detection of the uic binary as well as the sanity-tests normally run to ensure that the binary is available and working as expected.

prop.name: AUTOUIC_OPTIONS
prop.desc: Additional options for uic when using AUTOUIC

prop.name: AUTOUIC_SEARCH_PATHS
prop.desc: Search path list used by AUTOUIC to find included .ui files.

prop.name: AUTOUIC_SOURCE_GROUP
prop.desc: Name of the source_group() for AUTOUIC generated files.

prop.name: BINARY_DIR
prop.desc: This read-only property reports the value of the CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR variable in the directory in which the target was defined.

prop.name: BUILDSYSTEM_TARGETS
prop.desc: This read-only directory property contains a semicolon-separated list of buildsystem targets added in the directory by calls to the add_library(), add_executable(), and add_custom_target() commands. The list does not include any Imported Targets or Alias Targets, but does include Interface Libraries. Each entry in the list is the logical name of a target, suitable to pass to the get_property() command TARGET option.

prop.name: BUILD_RPATH
prop.desc: A semicolon-separated list specifying runtime path (RPATH) entries to add to binaries linked in the build tree (for platforms that support it). By default, CMake sets the runtime path of binaries in the build tree to contain search paths it knows are needed to find the shared libraries they link. Projects may set BUILD_RPATH to specify additional search paths.

prop.name: BUILD_RPATH_USE_ORIGIN
prop.desc: Whether to use relative paths for the build RPATH.

prop.name: BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_NAME_DIR
prop.desc: BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_NAME_DIR is a boolean specifying whether the macOS install_name of a target in the build tree uses the directory given by INSTALL_NAME_DIR. This setting only applies to targets on macOS.

prop.name: BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_RPATH
prop.desc: BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_RPATH is a boolean specifying whether to link the target in the build tree with the INSTALL_RPATH. This takes precedence over SKIP_BUILD_RPATH and avoids the need for relinking before installation.

prop.name: BUNDLE

prop.name: CLEAN_NO_CUSTOM

prop.desc: If set to True, the test will be skipped and its status will be 'Not Run'. A DISABLED test will not be counted in the total number of tests and its completion status will be reported to CDash as Disabled.

prop.name: DISABLED_FEATURES
prop.desc: List of features which are disabled during the CMake run.

prop.name: DISABLE_PRECOMPILE_HEADERS
prop.desc: Disables the precompilation of header files specified by PRECOMPILE_HEADERS property.

prop.name: DLL_NAME_WITH_SOVERSION
prop.desc: This property controls whether the SOVERSION target property is added to the filename of generated DLL filenames for the Windows platform, which is selected when the WIN32 variable is set.

prop.name: DOTNET_SDK
prop.desc: Specify the .NET SDK for C# projects. For example: Microsoft.NET.Sdk.

prop.name: DOTNET_TARGET_FRAMEWORK
prop.desc: Specify the .NET target framework.

prop.name: DOTNET_TARGET_FRAMEWORK_VERSION
prop.desc: Specify the .NET target framework version.

prop.name: ECLIPSE_EXTRA_CPROJECT_CONTENTS
prop.desc: Additional contents to be inserted into the generated Eclipse cproject file.

prop.name: ECLIPSE_EXTRA_NATURES
prop.desc: List of natures to add to the generated Eclipse project file.

prop.name: ENABLED_FEATURES
prop.desc: List of features which are enabled during the CMake run.

prop.name: ENABLED_LANGUAGES
prop.desc: Read-only property that contains the list of currently enabled languages

prop.name: ENABLE_EXPORTS
prop.desc: Specify whether an executable or a shared library exports symbols.

prop.name: ENVIRONMENT
prop.desc: Specify environment variables that should be defined for running a test.

prop.name: ENVIRONMENT_MODIFICATION
prop.desc: Specify environment variables that should be modified for running a test. Note that the operations performed by this property are performed after the ENVIRONMENT property is already applied.

prop.name: EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
prop.desc: Set this target property to a true (or false) value to exclude (or include) the target from the "all" target of the containing directory and its ancestors. If excluded, running e.g. make in the containing directory or its ancestors will not build the target by default.

prop.name: EXCLUDE_FROM_DEFAULT_BUILD
prop.desc: Exclude a target from the solution build configuration.

prop.name: EXCLUDE_FROM_DEFAULT_BUILD_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: Per-configuration version of target exclusion from Build Solution.

prop.name: EXPORT_BUILD_DATABASE
prop.desc: Enable/Disable output of a build database for a target.

prop.name: EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS
prop.desc: Enable/Disable output of compile commands during generation for a target.

prop.name: EXPORT_FIND_PACKAGE_NAME
prop.desc: Control the package name associated with a dependency target when exporting a find_dependency() call in install(PACKAGE_INFO), export(PACKAGE_INFO), install(EXPORT) or export(EXPORT). This can be used to assign a package name to a package that is built by CMake and exported, or a package that was provided by FetchContent.

prop.name: EXPORT_NAME
prop.desc: Exported name for target files.

prop.name: EXPORT_NO_SYSTEM
prop.desc: This property affects the behavior of the install(EXPORT) and export() commands when they install or export the target respectively. When EXPORT_NO_SYSTEM is set to true, those commands generate an imported target with SYSTEM property set to false.

prop.name: EXPORT_PROPERTIES
prop.desc: List additional properties to export for a target.

prop.name: EXTERNAL_OBJECT
prop.desc: If set to true then this is an object file.

prop.name: EchoString
prop.desc: A message to be displayed when the target is built.

prop.name: FAIL_REGULAR_EXPRESSION
prop.desc: If the test output (stdout or stderr) matches this regular expression the test will fail, regardless of the process exit code. Tests that exceed the timeout specified by TIMEOUT fail regardless of FAIL_REGULAR_EXPRESSION. Any non-zero return code or system-level test failures including segmentation faults, signal abort, or heap errors fail the test even if the regular expression does not match.

prop.name: FASTBUILD_CACHING
prop.desc: A target property that controls whether caching is enabled for the given target in the generated fbuild.bff.

prop.name: FASTBUILD_DISTRIBUTION
prop.desc: A target property that controls whether distribution is enabled for the given target in the generated fbuild.bff.

prop.name: FIND_LIBRARY_USE_LIB32_PATHS
prop.desc: Whether the find_library() command should automatically search lib32 directories.

prop.name: FIND_LIBRARY_USE_LIB64_PATHS
prop.desc: Whether find_library() should automatically search lib64 directories.

prop.name: FIND_LIBRARY_USE_LIBX32_PATHS
prop.desc: Whether the find_library() command should automatically search libx32 directories.

prop.name: FIND_LIBRARY_USE_OPENBSD_VERSIONING
prop.desc: Whether find_library() should find OpenBSD-style shared libraries.

prop.name: FIXTURES_CLEANUP
prop.desc: Specifies a list of fixtures for which the test is to be treated as a cleanup test. These fixture names are distinct from test case names and are not required to have any similarity to the names of tests associated with them.

prop.name: FIXTURES_REQUIRED
prop.desc: Specifies a list of fixtures the test requires. Fixture names are case sensitive and they are not required to have any similarity to test names.

prop.name: FIXTURES_SETUP
prop.desc: Specifies a list of fixtures for which the test is to be treated as a setup test. These fixture names are distinct from test case names and are not required to have any similarity to the names of tests associated with them.

prop.name: FOLDER
prop.desc: For IDEs that present targets using a folder hierarchy, this property specifies the name of the folder to place the target under. To nest folders, use FOLDER values such as GUI/Dialogs with / characters separating folder levels. Targets with no FOLDER property will appear as top level entities. Targets with the same FOLDER property value will appear in the same folder as siblings.

prop.name: FRAMEWORK
prop.desc: Build SHARED or STATIC library as Framework Bundle on the macOS and iOS.

prop.name: FRAMEWORK_MULTI_CONFIG_POSTFIX_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: Postfix to append to the framework file name for configuration <CONFIG>, when using a multi-config generator (like Xcode and Ninja Multi-Config).

prop.name: FRAMEWORK_VERSION
prop.desc: Version of a framework created using the FRAMEWORK target property (e.g. A).

prop.name: Fortran_BUILDING_INSTRINSIC_MODULES
prop.desc: A misspelled variant of the Fortran_BUILDING_INTRINSIC_MODULES target property.

prop.name: Fortran_BUILDING_INTRINSIC_MODULES
prop.desc: Instructs the CMake Fortran preprocessor that the target is building Fortran intrinsics for building a Fortran compiler.

prop.name: Fortran_CLANG_TIDY
prop.desc: This property is implemented only when <LANG> is C, CXX, OBJC or OBJCXX.

prop.name: Fortran_CLANG_TIDY_EXPORT_FIXES_DIR
prop.desc: This property is implemented only when <LANG> is C, CXX, OBJC or OBJCXX, and only has an effect when <LANG>_CLANG_TIDY is set.

prop.name: Fortran_COMPILER_LAUNCHER
prop.desc: This property is implemented only when <LANG> is C, CXX, Fortran, HIP, ISPC, OBJC, OBJCXX, or CUDA.

prop.name: Fortran_CPPCHECK
prop.desc: This property is supported only when <LANG> is C or CXX.

prop.name: Fortran_CPPLINT
prop.desc: This property is supported only when <LANG> is C or CXX.

prop.desc: Set to FIXED or FREE to indicate the Fortran source layout.

prop.desc: This property is supported only when <LANG> is C or CXX.

prop.name: Fortran_INCLUDE_WHAT_YOU_USE
prop.desc: This property is implemented only when <LANG> is C or CXX.

prop.name: Fortran_LINKER_LAUNCHER
prop.desc: This property is implemented only when <LANG> is one of:

prop.name: Fortran_MODULE_DIRECTORY
prop.desc: Specify output directory for Fortran modules provided by the target.

prop.name: Fortran_PREPROCESS
prop.desc: Control whether the Fortran source file should be unconditionally preprocessed.

prop.name: Fortran_STANDARD
prop.desc: The variations are:

prop.name: Fortran_STANDARD_REQUIRED
prop.desc: The variations are:

prop.name: Fortran_VISIBILITY_PRESET
prop.desc: Value for symbol visibility compile flags

prop.name: GENERATED
prop.desc: Is this source file generated as part of the build or CMake process.

prop.name: GENERATED_RESOURCE_SPEC_FILE
prop.desc: Path to the dynamically-generated resource spec file generated by this test.

prop.name: GENERATOR_FILE_NAME
prop.desc: Generator's file for this target.

prop.name: GENERATOR_IS_MULTI_CONFIG
prop.desc: Read-only property that is true on multi-configuration generators.

prop.name: GHS_INTEGRITY_APP
prop.desc: ON / OFF boolean to determine if an executable target should be treated as an Integrity Application.

prop.name: GHS_NO_SOURCE_GROUP_FILE
prop.desc: ON / OFF boolean to control if the project file for a target should be one single file or multiple files.

prop.name: GLOBAL_DEPENDS_DEBUG_MODE
prop.desc: Enable global target dependency graph debug mode.

prop.name: GLOBAL_DEPENDS_NO_CYCLES
prop.desc: Disallow global target dependency graph cycles.

prop.name: GNUtoMS
prop.desc: Convert GNU import library (.dll.a) to MS format (.lib).

prop.name: HAS_CXX
prop.desc: Link the target using the C++ linker tool (obsolete).

prop.name: HEADER_DIRS
prop.desc: Semicolon-separated list of base directories of the target's default header set (i.e. the file set with name and type HEADERS). The property supports generator expressions.

prop.name: HEADER_DIRS_<NAME>
prop.desc: Semicolon-separated list of base directories of the target's <NAME> header set, which has the set type HEADERS. The property supports generator expressions.

prop.name: HEADER_FILE_ONLY
prop.desc: Is this source file only a header file.

prop.name: HEADER_SET
prop.desc: Semicolon-separated list of files in the target's default header set, (i.e. the file set with name and type HEADERS). If any of the paths are relative, they are computed relative to the target's source directory. The property supports generator expressions.

prop.name: HEADER_SETS
prop.desc: Read-only list of the target's PRIVATE and PUBLIC header sets (i.e. all file sets with the type HEADERS). Files listed in these file sets are treated as source files for the purpose of IDE integration. The files also have their HEADER_FILE_ONLY property set to TRUE.

prop.name: HEADER_SET_<NAME>
prop.desc: Semicolon-separated list of files in the target's <NAME> header set, which has the set type HEADERS. If any of the paths are relative, they are computed relative to the target's source directory. The property supports generator expressions.

prop.name: HELPSTRING
prop.desc: Help associated with entry in GUIs.

prop.name: HIP_ARCHITECTURES
prop.desc: List of GPU architectures to for which to generate device code. Architecture names are interpreted based on CMAKE_HIP_PLATFORM.

prop.name: HIP_EXTENSIONS
prop.desc: Boolean specifying whether compiler specific extensions are requested.

prop.name: HIP_STANDARD
prop.desc: The HIP/C++ standard requested to build this target.

prop.name: HIP_STANDARD_REQUIRED
prop.desc: Boolean describing whether the value of HIP_STANDARD is a requirement.

prop.name: IMPLICIT_DEPENDS_INCLUDE_TRANSFORM
prop.desc: Specify #include line transforms for dependencies in a target.

prop.name: IMPORTED
prop.desc: Read-only indication of whether a target is IMPORTED.

prop.name: IMPORTED_COMMON_LANGUAGE_RUNTIME
prop.desc: Property to define if the target uses C++/CLI.

prop.name: IMPORTED_CONFIGURATIONS
prop.desc: Configurations provided for an imported target.

prop.name: IMPORTED_CXX_MODULES_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS
prop.desc: Preprocessor definitions for compiling an IMPORTED target's C++ module sources.

prop.name: IMPORTED_CXX_MODULES_COMPILE_FEATURES
prop.desc: Compiler features enabled for this IMPORTED target's C++ modules.

prop.name: IMPORTED_CXX_MODULES_COMPILE_OPTIONS
prop.desc: List of options to pass to the compiler for this IMPORTED target's C++ modules.

prop.name: IMPORTED_CXX_MODULES_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES
prop.desc: List of preprocessor include file search directories when compiling C++ modules for IMPORTED targets.

prop.name: IMPORTED_CXX_MODULES_LINK_LIBRARIES
prop.desc: List of direct dependencies to use for usage requirements for C++ modules in the target's C++ modules.

prop.name: IMPORTED_GLOBAL
prop.desc: Indication of whether an IMPORTED target is globally visible.

prop.name: IMPORTED_IMPLIB
prop.desc: Full path to the import library for an IMPORTED target.

prop.name: IMPORTED_IMPLIB_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: <CONFIG>-specific version of IMPORTED_IMPLIB property.

prop.name: IMPORTED_LIBNAME
prop.desc: Specify the link library name for an imported Interface Library.

prop.name: IMPORTED_LIBNAME_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: <CONFIG>-specific version of IMPORTED_LIBNAME property.

prop.name: IMPORTED_LINK_DEPENDENT_LIBRARIES
prop.desc: Dependent shared libraries of an imported shared library.

prop.name: IMPORTED_LINK_DEPENDENT_LIBRARIES_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: <CONFIG>-specific version of IMPORTED_LINK_DEPENDENT_LIBRARIES.

prop.name: IMPORTED_LINK_INTERFACE_LANGUAGES
prop.desc: Languages compiled into an IMPORTED static library.

prop.name: IMPORTED_LINK_INTERFACE_LANGUAGES_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: <CONFIG>-specific version of IMPORTED_LINK_INTERFACE_LANGUAGES.

prop.name: IMPORTED_LINK_INTERFACE_LIBRARIES
prop.desc: Transitive link interface of an IMPORTED target.

prop.name: IMPORTED_LINK_INTERFACE_LIBRARIES_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: <CONFIG>-specific version of IMPORTED_LINK_INTERFACE_LIBRARIES.

prop.name: IMPORTED_LINK_INTERFACE_MULTIPLICITY
prop.desc: Repetition count for cycles of IMPORTED static libraries.

prop.name: IMPORTED_LINK_INTERFACE_MULTIPLICITY_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: <CONFIG>-specific version of IMPORTED_LINK_INTERFACE_MULTIPLICITY.

prop.name: IMPORTED_LOCATION
prop.desc: Full path to the main file on disk for an IMPORTED target.

prop.name: IMPORTED_LOCATION_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: <CONFIG>-specific version of IMPORTED_LOCATION property.

prop.name: IMPORTED_NO_SONAME
prop.desc: Specifies that an IMPORTED shared library target has no soname.

prop.name: IMPORTED_NO_SONAME_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: <CONFIG>-specific version of IMPORTED_NO_SONAME property.

prop.name: IMPORTED_NO_SYSTEM
prop.desc: Setting IMPORTED_NO_SYSTEM to true on an imported target specifies that it is not a system target. This has the following effects:

prop.name: IMPORTED_OBJECTS
prop.desc: A semicolon-separated list of absolute paths to the object files on disk for an imported object library.

prop.name: IMPORTED_OBJECTS_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: <CONFIG>-specific version of IMPORTED_OBJECTS property.

prop.name: IMPORTED_SONAME
prop.desc: The soname of an IMPORTED target of shared library type.

prop.name: IMPORTED_SONAME_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: <CONFIG>-specific version of IMPORTED_SONAME property.

prop.name: IMPORTED_TARGETS
prop.desc: This read-only directory property contains a semicolon-separated list of Imported Targets added in the directory by calls to the add_library() and add_executable() commands. Each entry in the list is the logical name of a target, suitable to pass to the get_property() command TARGET option when called in the same directory.

prop.name: IMPORT_PREFIX
prop.desc: What comes before the import library name.

prop.name: IMPORT_SUFFIX
prop.desc: What comes after the import library name.

prop.name: INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES
prop.desc: List of preprocessor include file search directories.

prop.name: INCLUDE_REGULAR_EXPRESSION
prop.desc: Include file scanning regular expression.

prop.name: INSTALL_NAME_DIR
prop.desc: Directory name for installed targets on Apple platforms.

prop.name: INSTALL_OBJECT_NAME
prop.desc: Set the installed object name (without the object extension) of the source file. An empty string value disables custom object naming. The value must be a relative path, and may not include special directory components (e.g., ..).

prop.name: INSTALL_OBJECT_NAME_STRATEGY
prop.desc: INSTALL_OBJECT_NAME_STRATEGY is a string target property variable specifying the strategy to use when naming installed object files. The supported values are:

prop.name: INSTALL_OBJECT_ONLY_USE_DESTINATION
prop.desc: Controls whether the install(DESTINATION) for object libraries is used as-is or supplemented with conflict-avoiding subdirectories.

prop.name: INSTALL_PARALLEL
prop.desc: Enables parallel installation option for a project. The install code for each subdirectory added with add_subdirectory can run independently.

prop.name: INSTALL_REMOVE_ENVIRONMENT_RPATH
prop.desc: Controls whether toolchain-defined rpaths should be removed during installation.

prop.name: INSTALL_RPATH
prop.desc: The rpath to use for installed targets.

prop.name: INSTALL_RPATH_USE_LINK_PATH
prop.desc: Add paths to linker search and installed rpath.

prop.name: INTERFACE_AUTOMOC_MACRO_NAMES
prop.desc: A semicolon-separated list of macro names for AUTOMOC to be propagated to consumers.

prop.name: INTERFACE_AUTOUIC_OPTIONS
prop.desc: List of interface options to pass to uic.

prop.name: INTERFACE_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS
prop.desc: List of public compile definitions requirements for a library.

prop.name: INTERFACE_COMPILE_FEATURES
prop.desc: List of public compile features requirements for a library.

prop.name: INTERFACE_COMPILE_OPTIONS
prop.desc: List of public compile options requirements for a library.

prop.name: INTERFACE_CXX_MODULE_SETS
prop.desc: Read-only list of the target's PUBLIC C++ module sets (i.e. all file sets with the type CXX_MODULES). Files listed in these C++ module sets can be installed with install(TARGETS) and exported with install(EXPORT) and export().

prop.name: INTERFACE_HEADER_SETS
prop.desc: Read-only list of the target's INTERFACE and PUBLIC header sets (i.e. all file sets with the type HEADERS). Files listed in these header sets can be installed with install(TARGETS) and exported with install(EXPORT) and export().

prop.name: INTERFACE_HEADER_SETS_TO_VERIFY
prop.desc: Used to specify which PUBLIC and INTERFACE header sets of a target should be verified.

prop.name: INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES
prop.desc: List of public include directories requirements for a library.

prop.name: INTERFACE_LINK_DEPENDS
prop.desc: Additional public interface files on which a target binary depends for linking.

prop.name: INTERFACE_LINK_DIRECTORIES
prop.desc: List of public link directories requirements for a library.

prop.name: INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES
prop.desc: List public interface libraries for a library.

prop.name: INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES_DIRECT
prop.desc: List of libraries that consumers of this library should treat as direct link dependencies.

prop.name: INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES_DIRECT_EXCLUDE
prop.desc: List of libraries that consumers of this library should not treat as direct link dependencies.

prop.name: INTERFACE_LINK_OPTIONS
prop.desc: List of public link options requirements for a library.

prop.name: INTERFACE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE
prop.desc: Whether consumers need to create a position-independent target

prop.name: INTERFACE_PRECOMPILE_HEADERS
prop.desc: List of interface header files to precompile into consuming targets.

prop.name: INTERFACE_SOURCES
prop.desc: List of interface sources to compile into consuming targets.

prop.name: INTERFACE_SYSTEM_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES
prop.desc: List of public system include directories for a library.

prop.name: INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION
prop.desc: Enable interprocedural optimization for a target.

prop.name: INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: Per-configuration interprocedural optimization for a target.

prop.name: IN_TRY_COMPILE
prop.desc: Read-only property that is true during a try-compile configuration.

prop.name: IOS_INSTALL_COMBINED
prop.desc: Build a combined (device and simulator) target when installing.

prop.name: ISPC_HEADER_DIRECTORY
prop.desc: Specify relative output directory for ISPC headers provided by the target.

prop.name: ISPC_HEADER_SUFFIX
prop.desc: Specify output suffix to be used for ISPC generated headers provided by the target.

prop.name: ISPC_INSTRUCTION_SETS
prop.desc: List of instruction set architectures to generate code for.

prop.name: JOB_POOLS
prop.desc: Ninja only: List of available pools.

prop.name: JOB_POOL_COMPILE
prop.desc: Ninja only: Pool used for compiling.

prop.name: JOB_POOL_LINK
prop.desc: Ninja only: Pool used for linking.

prop.name: JOB_POOL_PRECOMPILE_HEADER
prop.desc: Ninja only: Pool used for generating pre-compiled headers.
