prop.desc: Make the output file have the same extension as the source file.

prop.name: LABELS
prop.desc: Specify a list of text labels associated with a target.

prop.name: LANGUAGE
prop.desc: Specify the programming language in which a source file is written.

prop.name: LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
prop.desc: Output directory in which to build LIBRARY target files.

prop.name: LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: Per-configuration output directory for LIBRARY target files.

prop.name: LIBRARY_OUTPUT_NAME
prop.desc: Output name for LIBRARY target files.

prop.name: LIBRARY_OUTPUT_NAME_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: Per-configuration output name for LIBRARY target files.

prop.name: LINKER_LANGUAGE
prop.desc: Specifies language whose compiler will invoke the linker.

prop.name: LINKER_TYPE
prop.desc: Specify which linker will be used for the link step. The property value may use generator expressions.

prop.name: LINK_DEPENDS
prop.desc: Additional files on which a target binary depends for linking.

prop.name: LINK_DEPENDS_NO_SHARED
prop.desc: Do not depend on linked shared library files.

prop.name: LINK_DIRECTORIES
prop.desc: List of directories to use for the link step of shared library, module and executable targets.

prop.name: LINK_FLAGS
prop.desc: Additional flags to use when linking this target if it is a shared library, module library, or an executable. Static libraries need to use STATIC_LIBRARY_OPTIONS or STATIC_LIBRARY_FLAGS properties.

prop.name: LINK_FLAGS_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: Per-configuration linker flags for a SHARED library, MODULE or EXECUTABLE target.

prop.name: LINK_INTERFACE_LIBRARIES
prop.desc: List public interface libraries for a shared library or executable.

prop.name: LINK_INTERFACE_LIBRARIES_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: Per-configuration list of public interface libraries for a target.

prop.name: LINK_INTERFACE_MULTIPLICITY
prop.desc: Repetition count for STATIC libraries with cyclic dependencies.

prop.name: LINK_INTERFACE_MULTIPLICITY_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: Per-configuration repetition count for cycles of STATIC libraries.

prop.name: LINK_LIBRARIES
prop.desc: List of direct link dependencies.

prop.name: LINK_LIBRARIES_ONLY_TARGETS
prop.desc: Enforce that link items that can be target names are actually existing targets.

prop.name: LINK_LIBRARIES_STRATEGY
prop.desc: Specify a strategy for ordering a target's direct link dependencies on linker command lines. This property is initialized by the value of the CMAKE_LINK_LIBRARIES_STRATEGY variable if it is set when a target is created.

prop.name: LINK_LIBRARY_OVERRIDE
prop.desc: Override the library features associated with libraries from LINK_LIBRARY generator expressions. This can be used to resolve incompatible library features that result from specifying different features for the same library in different LINK_LIBRARY generator expressions.

prop.name: LINK_LIBRARY_OVERRIDE_<LIBRARY>
prop.desc: Override the library feature associated with <LIBRARY> from LINK_LIBRARY generator expressions. This can be used to resolve incompatible library features that result from specifying different features for <LIBRARY> in different LINK_LIBRARY generator expressions.

prop.name: LINK_OPTIONS
prop.desc: List of options to use for the link step of shared library, module and executable targets as well as the device link step. Targets that are static libraries need to use the STATIC_LIBRARY_OPTIONS target property.

prop.name: LINK_SEARCH_END_STATIC
prop.desc: End a link line such that static system libraries are used.

prop.name: LINK_SEARCH_START_STATIC
prop.desc: Assume the linker looks for static libraries by default.

prop.name: LINK_WARNING_AS_ERROR
prop.desc: Specify whether to treat warnings on link as errors. If enabled, adds a flag to treat warnings on link as errors. If the cmake --link-no-warning-as-error option is given on the cmake(1) command line, this property is ignored.

prop.name: LINK_WHAT_YOU_USE
prop.desc: This is a boolean option that, when set to TRUE, adds a link-time check to print a list of shared libraries that are being linked but provide no symbols used by the target. This is intended as a lint.

prop.name: LISTFILE_STACK
prop.desc: The current stack of listfiles being processed.

prop.name: LOCATION
prop.desc: Read-only location of a target on disk.

prop.name: LOCATION_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: Read-only property providing a target location on disk.

prop.name: MACHO_COMPATIBILITY_VERSION
prop.desc: What compatibility version number is this target for Mach-O binaries.

prop.name: MACHO_CURRENT_VERSION
prop.desc: What current version number is this target for Mach-O binaries.

prop.name: MACOSX_BUNDLE
prop.desc: Build an executable as an Application Bundle on macOS or iOS.

prop.name: MACOSX_BUNDLE_INFO_PLIST
prop.desc: Specify a custom Info.plist template for a macOS and iOS Application Bundle.

prop.name: MACOSX_FRAMEWORK_INFO_PLIST
prop.desc: Specify a custom Info.plist template for a macOS and iOS Framework.

prop.name: MACOSX_PACKAGE_LOCATION
prop.desc: Place a source file inside a Application Bundle (MACOSX_BUNDLE), Core Foundation Bundle (BUNDLE), or Framework Bundle (FRAMEWORK). It is applicable for macOS and iOS.

prop.name: MACOSX_RPATH
prop.desc: Whether this target on macOS or iOS is located at runtime using rpaths.

prop.name: MACROS
prop.desc: List of macro commands available in the current directory.

prop.name: MANUALLY_ADDED_DEPENDENCIES
prop.desc: Get manually added dependencies to other top-level targets.

prop.name: MAP_IMPORTED_CONFIG_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: Map from project configuration to imported target's configuration.

prop.name: MEASUREMENT
prop.desc: Specify a CDASH measurement and value to be reported for a test.

prop.name: MODIFIED
prop.desc: Internal management property. Do not set or get.

prop.name: MSVC_DEBUG_INFORMATION_FORMAT
prop.desc: Select debug information format when targeting the MSVC ABI.

prop.name: MSVC_RUNTIME_CHECKS
prop.desc: Select the list of enabled runtime checks when targeting the MSVC ABI.

prop.name: MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY
prop.desc: Select the MSVC runtime library for use by compilers targeting the MSVC ABI.

prop.name: NAME
prop.desc: Logical name for the target.

prop.name: NO_SONAME
prop.desc: Whether to set soname when linking a shared library.

prop.name: NO_SYSTEM_FROM_IMPORTED
prop.desc: Do not treat include directories from the interfaces of consumed Imported Targets as system directories.

prop.name: OBJCXX_EXTENSIONS
prop.desc: Boolean specifying whether compiler specific extensions are requested.

prop.name: OBJCXX_STANDARD
prop.desc: The ObjC++ standard whose features are requested to build this target.

prop.name: OBJCXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED
prop.desc: Boolean describing whether the value of OBJCXX_STANDARD is a requirement.

prop.name: OBJC_EXTENSIONS
prop.desc: Boolean specifying whether compiler specific extensions are requested.

prop.name: OBJC_STANDARD
prop.desc: The OBJC standard whose features are requested to build this target.

prop.name: OBJC_STANDARD_REQUIRED
prop.desc: Boolean describing whether the value of OBJC_STANDARD is a requirement.

prop.name: OBJECT_DEPENDS
prop.desc: Additional files on which a compiled object file depends.

prop.name: OBJECT_NAME
prop.desc: Set the object name (without the object extension) of the source file. An empty string value disables custom object naming. The value must be a relative path, and may not include special directory components (e.g., ..).

prop.name: OBJECT_OUTPUTS
prop.desc: Additional outputs for a Ninja or Makefile Generators rule.

prop.name: OPTIMIZE_DEPENDENCIES
prop.desc: Activates dependency optimization of static and object libraries.

prop.name: OSX_ARCHITECTURES
prop.desc: Target specific architectures for macOS.

prop.name: OSX_ARCHITECTURES_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: Per-configuration macOS and iOS binary architectures for a target.

prop.name: OUTPUT_NAME
prop.desc: Output name for target files.

prop.name: OUTPUT_NAME_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: Per-configuration target file base name.

prop.name: PACKAGES_FOUND
prop.desc: List of packages which were found during the CMake run.

prop.name: PACKAGES_NOT_FOUND
prop.desc: List of packages which were not found during the CMake run.

prop.name: PARENT_DIRECTORY
prop.desc: Source directory that added current subdirectory.

prop.name: PASS_REGULAR_EXPRESSION
prop.desc: The test output (stdout or stderr) must match this regular expression for the test to pass. The process exit code is ignored. Tests that exceed the timeout specified by TIMEOUT still fail regardless of PASS_REGULAR_EXPRESSION. System-level test failures including segmentation faults, signal abort, or heap errors may fail the test even if PASS_REGULAR_EXPRESSION is matched.

prop.name: PCH_INSTANTIATE_TEMPLATES
prop.desc: When this property is set to true, the precompiled header compiler options will contain a flag to instantiate templates during the generation of the PCH if supported. This can significantly improve compile times. Supported in Clang since version 11.

prop.name: PCH_WARN_INVALID
prop.desc: When this property is set to true, the precompile header compiler options will contain a compiler flag which should warn about invalid precompiled headers e.g. -Winvalid-pch for GNU compiler.

prop.name: PDB_NAME
prop.desc: Output name for the MS debug symbol .pdb file generated by the linker for an executable or shared library target.

prop.name: PDB_NAME_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: Per-configuration output name for the MS debug symbol .pdb file generated by the linker for an executable or shared library target.

prop.name: PDB_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
prop.desc: Output directory for the MS debug symbols .pdb file generated by the linker for an executable or shared library target.

prop.name: PDB_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: Per-configuration output directory for the MS debug symbol .pdb file generated by the linker for an executable or shared library target.

prop.name: POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE
prop.desc: A target property that specifies whether to create a target that has position-independent code enabled.

prop.name: POST_INSTALL_SCRIPT
prop.desc: Deprecated install support.

prop.name: PRECOMPILE_HEADERS
prop.desc: List of header files to precompile.

prop.name: PRECOMPILE_HEADERS_REUSE_FROM
prop.desc: Target from which to reuse the precompiled headers build artifact.

prop.name: PREDEFINED_TARGETS_FOLDER
prop.desc: Name of FOLDER for targets that are added automatically by CMake.

prop.name: PREFIX
prop.desc: What comes before the library name.

prop.name: PRE_INSTALL_SCRIPT
prop.desc: Deprecated install support.

prop.name: PRIVATE_HEADER
prop.desc: Specify private header files in a FRAMEWORK shared library target.

prop.name: PROCESSORS
prop.desc: Set to specify how many process slots this test requires. If not set, the default is 1 processor.

prop.name: PROCESSOR_AFFINITY
prop.desc: Set to a true value to ask CTest to launch the test process with CPU affinity for a fixed set of processors. If enabled and supported for the current platform, CTest will choose a set of processors to place in the CPU affinity mask when launching the test process. The number of processors in the set is determined by the PROCESSORS test property or the number of processors available to CTest, whichever is smaller. The set of processors chosen will be disjoint from the processors assigned to other concurrently running tests that also have the PROCESSOR_AFFINITY property enabled.

prop.name: PROJECT_LABEL
prop.desc: Change the name of a target in an IDE.

prop.name: PROPAGATE_TOP_LEVEL_INCLUDES_TO_TRY_COMPILE
prop.desc: When this global property is set to true, the CMAKE_PROJECT_TOP_LEVEL_INCLUDES variable is propagated into try_compile() calls that use the whole-project signature. Calls to the source file signature are not affected by this property. PROPAGATE_TOP_LEVEL_INCLUDES_TO_TRY_COMPILE is unset by default.

prop.name: PUBLIC_HEADER
prop.desc: Specify public header files in a FRAMEWORK shared library target.

prop.name: RC_CLANG_TIDY
prop.desc: This property is implemented only when <LANG> is C, CXX, OBJC or OBJCXX.

prop.name: RC_CLANG_TIDY_EXPORT_FIXES_DIR
prop.desc: This property is implemented only when <LANG> is C, CXX, OBJC or OBJCXX, and only has an effect when <LANG>_CLANG_TIDY is set.

prop.name: RC_COMPILER_LAUNCHER
prop.desc: This property is implemented only when <LANG> is C, CXX, Fortran, HIP, ISPC, OBJC, OBJCXX, or CUDA.

prop.name: RC_CPPCHECK
prop.desc: This property is supported only when <LANG> is C or CXX.

prop.name: RC_CPPLINT
prop.desc: This property is supported only when <LANG> is C or CXX.

prop.name: RC_EXTENSIONS
prop.desc: The variations are:

prop.name: RC_ICSTAT
prop.desc: This property is supported only when <LANG> is C or CXX.

prop.name: RC_INCLUDE_WHAT_YOU_USE
prop.desc: This property is implemented only when <LANG> is C or CXX.

prop.name: RC_LINKER_LAUNCHER
prop.desc: This property is implemented only when <LANG> is one of:

prop.name: RC_STANDARD
prop.desc: The variations are:

prop.name: RC_STANDARD_REQUIRED
prop.desc: The variations are:

prop.name: RC_VISIBILITY_PRESET
prop.desc: Value for symbol visibility compile flags

prop.name: REPORT_UNDEFINED_PROPERTIES
prop.desc: If set, report any undefined properties to this file.

prop.name: REQUIRED_FILES
prop.desc: List of files required to run the test. The filenames are relative to the test WORKING_DIRECTORY unless an absolute path is specified.

prop.name: RESOURCE
prop.desc: Specify resource files in a FRAMEWORK or BUNDLE.

prop.name: RESOURCE_GROUPS
prop.desc: Specify resources required by a test, grouped in a way that is meaningful to the test. See resource allocation for more information on how this property integrates into the CTest resource allocation feature.

prop.name: RESOURCE_LOCK
prop.desc: Specify a list of resources that are locked by this test.

prop.name: RULE_LAUNCH_COMPILE
prop.desc: Specify a launcher for compile rules.

prop.name: RULE_LAUNCH_CUSTOM
prop.desc: Specify a launcher for custom rules.

prop.name: RULE_LAUNCH_LINK
prop.desc: Specify a launcher for link rules.

prop.name: RULE_MESSAGES
prop.desc: Specify whether to report a message for each make rule.

prop.name: RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
prop.desc: Output directory in which to build RUNTIME target files.

prop.name: RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: Per-configuration output directory for RUNTIME target files.

prop.name: RUNTIME_OUTPUT_NAME
prop.desc: Output name for RUNTIME target files.

prop.name: RUNTIME_OUTPUT_NAME_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: Per-configuration output name for RUNTIME target files.

prop.name: RUN_SERIAL
prop.desc: Do not run this test in parallel with any other test.

prop.name: SKIP_AUTOGEN
prop.desc: Exclude the source file from AUTOMOC, AUTOUIC and AUTORCC processing (for Qt projects).

prop.name: SKIP_AUTOMOC
prop.desc: Exclude the source file from AUTOMOC processing (for Qt projects).

prop.name: SKIP_AUTORCC
prop.desc: Exclude the source file from AUTORCC processing (for Qt projects).

prop.name: SKIP_AUTOUIC
prop.desc: Exclude the source file from AUTOUIC processing (for Qt projects).

prop.name: SKIP_BUILD_RPATH
prop.desc: Should rpaths be used for the build tree.

prop.name: SKIP_LINTING
prop.desc: Exclude all sources of a target from running configured linting tools.

prop.name: SKIP_PRECOMPILE_HEADERS
prop.desc: Is this source file skipped by PRECOMPILE_HEADERS feature.

prop.name: SKIP_REGULAR_EXPRESSION
prop.desc: If the test output (stderr or stdout) matches this regular expression the test will be marked as skipped, regardless of the process exit code. Tests that exceed the timeout specified by TIMEOUT still fail regardless of SKIP_REGULAR_EXPRESSION. System-level test failures including segmentation faults, signal abort, or heap errors may fail the test even if the regular expression matches.

prop.name: SKIP_RETURN_CODE
prop.desc: Return code to mark a test as skipped.

prop.name: SKIP_UNITY_BUILD_INCLUSION
prop.desc: Setting this property to true ensures the source file will be skipped by unity builds when its associated target has its UNITY_BUILD property set to true. The source file will instead be compiled on its own in the same way as it would with unity builds disabled.

prop.name: SOURCES
prop.desc: This specifies the list of paths to source files for the target. The following commands all set or add to the SOURCES target property and are the usual way to manipulate it:

prop.name: SOURCE_DIR
prop.desc: This read-only property reports the value of the CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR variable in the directory in which the target was defined.

prop.name: SOVERSION
prop.desc: ABI version number of a shared library target.

prop.name: SPDX_LICENSE
prop.desc: Specify the license(s) of a target using a System Package Data Exchange (SPDX) License Expression. See the SPDX License List for a list of commonly used licenses and their identifiers.

prop.name: STATIC_LIBRARY_FLAGS
prop.desc: Archiver (or MSVC librarian) flags for a static library target. Targets that are shared libraries, modules, or executables need to use the LINK_OPTIONS or LINK_FLAGS target properties.

prop.name: STATIC_LIBRARY_FLAGS_<CONFIG>
prop.desc: Per-configuration archiver (or MSVC librarian) flags for a static library target.

prop.name: STATIC_LIBRARY_OPTIONS
prop.desc: Archiver (or MSVC librarian) flags for a static library target. Targets that are shared libraries, modules, or executables need to use the LINK_OPTIONS target property.

prop.name: STRINGS
prop.desc: Enumerate possible STRING entry values for GUI selection.

prop.name: SUBDIRECTORIES
prop.desc: This read-only directory property contains a semicolon-separated list of subdirectories processed so far by the add_subdirectory() or subdirs() commands. Each entry is the absolute path to the source directory (containing the CMakeLists.txt file). This is suitable to pass to the get_property() command DIRECTORY option.

prop.name: SUFFIX
prop.desc: What comes after the target name.

prop.name: SYMBOLIC
prop.desc: Read-only indication of whether a target is SYMBOLIC.

prop.name: SYSTEM
prop.desc: Specifies that a target is a system target. This has the following effects:

prop.name: Swift_CLANG_TIDY
prop.desc: This property is implemented only when <LANG> is C, CXX, OBJC or OBJCXX.

prop.name: Swift_CLANG_TIDY_EXPORT_FIXES_DIR
prop.desc: This property is implemented only when <LANG> is C, CXX, OBJC or OBJCXX, and only has an effect when <LANG>_CLANG_TIDY is set.

prop.name: Swift_COMPILATION_MODE
prop.desc: Specify how Swift compiles a target.

prop.name: Swift_COMPILER_LAUNCHER
prop.desc: This property is implemented only when <LANG> is C, CXX, Fortran, HIP, ISPC, OBJC, OBJCXX, or CUDA.

prop.name: Swift_CPPCHECK
prop.desc: This property is supported only when <LANG> is C or CXX.

prop.name: Swift_CPPLINT
prop.desc: This property is supported only when <LANG> is C or CXX.

prop.name: Swift_DEPENDENCIES_FILE
prop.desc: This property sets the path for the Swift dependency file (swiftdep) for the target. If one is not specified, it will default to <TARGET>.swiftdeps.

prop.name: Swift_DIAGNOSTICS_FILE
prop.desc: This property controls where the Swift diagnostics are serialized.

prop.name: Swift_EXTENSIONS
prop.desc: The variations are:

prop.name: Swift_ICSTAT
prop.desc: This property is supported only when <LANG> is C or CXX.

prop.name: Swift_INCLUDE_WHAT_YOU_USE
prop.desc: This property is implemented only when <LANG> is C or CXX.

prop.name: Swift_LANGUAGE_VERSION
prop.desc: This property sets the language version for the Swift sources in the target. If one is not specified, it will default to CMAKE_Swift_LANGUAGE_VERSION if specified, otherwise it is the latest version supported by the compiler.

prop.name: Swift_LINKER_LAUNCHER
prop.desc: This property is implemented only when <LANG> is one of:

prop.name: Swift_MODULE_DIRECTORY
prop.desc: Specify output directory for Swift modules provided by the target.

prop.name: Swift_MODULE_NAME
prop.desc: This property specifies the name of the Swift module. It is defaulted to the name of the target.

prop.name: Swift_STANDARD
prop.desc: The variations are:

prop.name: Swift_STANDARD_REQUIRED
prop.desc: The variations are:

prop.name: Swift_VISIBILITY_PRESET
prop.desc: Value for symbol visibility compile flags

prop.name: TARGET_ARCHIVES_MAY_BE_SHARED_LIBS
prop.desc: Set if shared libraries may be named like archives.

prop.name: TARGET_MESSAGES
prop.desc: Specify whether to report the completion of each target.

prop.name: TARGET_SUPPORTS_SHARED_LIBS
prop.desc: Does the target platform support shared libraries.

prop.name: TESTS
prop.desc: List of tests.

prop.name: TEST_INCLUDE_FILE
prop.desc: The TEST_INCLUDE_FILE directory property specifies a CMake script that is included and processed when ctest is run on the directory.

prop.name: TEST_INCLUDE_FILES
prop.desc: This directory property specifies a list of CMake scripts to be included and processed when ctest runs on the directory. Use absolute paths, to avoid ambiguity. Script files are included in the specified order.

prop.name: TEST_LAUNCHER
prop.desc: Use the given launcher to run executables. This command will be added as a prefix to add_test() commands for build target system executables and is meant to be run on the host machine.

prop.name: TIMEOUT
prop.desc: How many seconds to allow for this test.

prop.name: TIMEOUT_AFTER_MATCH
prop.desc: Change a test's timeout duration after a matching line is encountered in its output.

prop.name: TIMEOUT_SIGNAL_GRACE_PERIOD
prop.desc: If the TIMEOUT_SIGNAL_NAME test property is set, this property specifies the number of seconds to wait for a test process to terminate after sending the custom signal. Otherwise, this property has no meaning.

prop.name: TIMEOUT_SIGNAL_NAME
prop.desc: Specify a custom signal to send to a test process when its timeout is reached. This is available only on platforms supporting POSIX signals. It is not available on Windows.

prop.name: TRANSITIVE_COMPILE_PROPERTIES
prop.desc: Properties that the TARGET_PROPERTY generator expression, on the target and its dependents, evaluates as the union of values collected from the transitive closure of link dependencies, excluding entries guarded by LINK_ONLY.

prop.name: TRANSITIVE_LINK_PROPERTIES
prop.desc: Properties that the TARGET_PROPERTY generator expression, on the target and its dependents, evaluates as the union of values collected from the transitive closure of link dependencies, including entries guarded by LINK_ONLY.

prop.name: TYPE
prop.desc: The type of the target.

prop.name: UNITY_BUILD
prop.desc: When this property is set to true, the target source files will be combined into batches for faster compilation. This is done by creating a (set of) unity sources which #include the original sources, then compiling these unity sources instead of the originals. This is known as a Unity or Jumbo build.

prop.name: UNITY_BUILD_BATCH_SIZE
prop.desc: Specifies the maximum number of source files that can be combined into any one unity source file when unity builds are enabled by the UNITY_BUILD target property. The original source files will be distributed across as many unity source files as necessary to honor this limit.

prop.name: UNITY_BUILD_CODE_AFTER_INCLUDE
prop.desc: Code snippet which is included verbatim by the UNITY_BUILD feature just after every #include statement in the generated unity source files. For example:

prop.name: UNITY_BUILD_CODE_BEFORE_INCLUDE
prop.desc: Code snippet which is included verbatim by the UNITY_BUILD feature just before every #include statement in the generated unity source files. For example:

prop.name: UNITY_BUILD_FILENAME_PREFIX
prop.desc: By default, the unity file generated when UNITY_BUILD is enabled is of the form unity_<index>_<suffix>, where <suffix> is language-specific.

prop.name: UNITY_BUILD_MODE
prop.desc: CMake provides different algorithms for selecting which sources are grouped together into a bucket. Selection is decided by this property, which has the following acceptable values:

prop.name: UNITY_BUILD_RELOCATABLE
prop.desc: By default, the unity file generated when UNITY_BUILD is enabled uses absolute paths to reference the original source files. This causes the unity file to result in a different output depending on the location of the source files.

prop.name: UNITY_BUILD_UNIQUE_ID
prop.desc: The name of a valid C-identifier which is set to a unique per-file value during unity builds.

prop.name: UNITY_GROUP
prop.desc: This property controls which bucket the source will be part of when the UNITY_BUILD_MODE is set to GROUP.

prop.name: USE_FOLDERS
prop.desc: Controls whether to use the FOLDER target property to organize targets into folders. The value of USE_FOLDERS at the end of the top level CMakeLists.txt file is what determines the behavior.

prop.name: VALUE
prop.desc: Value of a cache entry.

prop.name: VARIABLES
prop.desc: List of variables defined in the current directory.

prop.name: VERIFY_INTERFACE_HEADER_SETS
prop.desc: Used to verify that all headers in a target's PUBLIC and INTERFACE header sets can be included on their own.

prop.name: VERSION
prop.desc: Version number of a shared library target.

prop.name: VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN
prop.desc: Whether to add a compile flag to hide symbols of inline functions

prop.name: VS_CONFIGURATION_TYPE
prop.desc: Visual Studio project configuration type.

prop.name: VS_COPY_TO_OUT_DIR
prop.desc: Sets the <CopyToOutputDirectory> tag for a source file in a Visual Studio project file. Valid values are Never, Always and PreserveNewest.

prop.name: VS_CSHARP_<tagname>
prop.desc: Visual Studio and CSharp source-file-specific configuration.

prop.name: VS_CUSTOM_COMMAND_DISABLE_PARALLEL_BUILD
prop.desc: A boolean property that disables parallel building for the source file in Visual Studio if it is built via add_custom_command() and is the MAIN_DEPENDENCY input for the custom command. See policy CMP0147.

prop.name: VS_DEBUGGER_COMMAND
prop.desc: Sets the local debugger command for Visual Studio C++ targets. The property value may use generator expressions. This is defined in <LocalDebuggerCommand> in the Visual Studio project file. This property is initialized by the value of the variable CMAKE_VS_DEBUGGER_COMMAND if it is set when a target is created.

prop.name: VS_DEBUGGER_COMMAND_ARGUMENTS
prop.desc: Sets the local debugger command line arguments for Visual Studio C++ targets. The property value may use generator expressions. This is defined in <LocalDebuggerCommandArguments> in the Visual Studio project file. This property is initialized by the value of the variable CMAKE_VS_DEBUGGER_COMMAND_ARGUMENTS if it is set when a target is created.

prop.name: VS_DEBUGGER_ENVIRONMENT
prop.desc: Sets the local debugger environment for Visual Studio C++ targets. The property value may use generator expressions. This is defined in <LocalDebuggerEnvironment> in the Visual Studio project file. This property is initialized by the value of the variable CMAKE_VS_DEBUGGER_ENVIRONMENT if it is set when a target is created.

prop.name: VS_DEBUGGER_WORKING_DIRECTORY
prop.desc: Sets the local debugger working directory for Visual Studio C++ targets. The property value may use generator expressions. This is defined in <LocalDebuggerWorkingDirectory> in the Visual Studio project file. This property is initialized by the value of the variable CMAKE_VS_DEBUGGER_WORKING_DIRECTORY if it is set when a target is created.

prop.name: VS_DEPLOYMENT_CONTENT
prop.desc: Mark a source file as content for deployment with a Windows Phone or Windows Store application when built with a Visual Studio Generators. The value must evaluate to either 1 or 0 and may use generator expressions to make the choice based on the build configuration. The .vcxproj file entry for the source file will be marked either DeploymentContent or ExcludedFromBuild for values 1 and 0, respectively.

prop.name: VS_DEPLOYMENT_LOCATION
prop.desc: Specifies the deployment location for a content source file with a Windows Phone or Windows Store application when built with a Visual Studio generators. This property is only applicable when using VS_DEPLOYMENT_CONTENT. The value represent the path relative to the app package and applies to all configurations.

prop.name: VS_DESKTOP_EXTENSIONS_VERSION
prop.desc: Visual Studio Windows 10 Desktop Extensions Version

prop.name: VS_DOTNET_DOCUMENTATION_FILE
prop.desc: Visual Studio managed project .NET documentation output

prop.name: VS_DOTNET_REFERENCEPROP_<refname>_TAG_<tagname>
prop.desc: Defines an XML property <tagname> for a .NET reference <refname>.

prop.name: VS_DOTNET_REFERENCES
prop.desc: Visual Studio managed project .NET references

prop.name: VS_DOTNET_REFERENCES_COPY_LOCAL
prop.desc: Sets the Copy Local property for all .NET hint references in the target

prop.name: VS_DOTNET_REFERENCE_<refname>
prop.desc: Visual Studio managed project .NET reference with name <refname> and hint path.

prop.name: VS_DOTNET_STARTUP_OBJECT
prop.desc: Sets the startup object property in Visual Studio .NET targets. The property value defines a full qualified class name (including package name), for example: MyCompany.Package.MyStarterClass.

prop.name: VS_DOTNET_TARGET_FRAMEWORK_VERSION
prop.desc: Specify the .NET target framework version.

prop.name: VS_DPI_AWARE
prop.desc: Set the Manifest Tool -> Input and Output -> DPI Awareness in the Visual Studio target project properties.

prop.name: VS_FILTER_PROPS
prop.desc: Sets the filter props file to be included in the visual studio C++ project filter file.

prop.name: VS_FRAMEWORK_REFERENCES
prop.desc: Visual Studio framework references. Specify a semicolon-separated list of framework references to be added to a generated Visual Studio project. For example:

prop.name: VS_GLOBAL_<variable>
prop.desc: Visual Studio project-specific global variable.

prop.name: VS_GLOBAL_KEYWORD
prop.desc: Visual Studio project keyword.

prop.name: VS_GLOBAL_PROJECT_TYPES
prop.desc: Visual Studio project type(s).

prop.name: VS_GLOBAL_ROOTNAMESPACE
prop.desc: Visual Studio project root namespace.

prop.name: VS_GLOBAL_SECTION_POST_<section>
prop.desc: Specify a postSolution global section in Visual Studio.

prop.name: VS_GLOBAL_SECTION_PRE_<section>
prop.desc: Specify a preSolution global section in Visual Studio.

prop.name: VS_INCLUDE_IN_VSIX
prop.desc: Boolean property to specify if the file should be included within a VSIX (Visual Studio Integration Extension) extension package. This is needed for development of Visual Studio extensions.

prop.name: VS_IOT_EXTENSIONS_VERSION
prop.desc: Visual Studio Windows 10 IoT Extensions Version

prop.name: VS_IOT_STARTUP_TASK
prop.desc: Visual Studio Windows 10 IoT Continuous Background Task

prop.name: VS_JUST_MY_CODE_DEBUGGING
prop.desc: Enable Just My Code with Visual Studio debugger.

prop.name: VS_KEYWORD
prop.desc: Removed. This once specified the Visual Studio project keyword for the Visual Studio 9 2008 generator, and older, but all of those generators have been removed.

prop.name: VS_MOBILE_EXTENSIONS_VERSION
prop.desc: Visual Studio Windows 10 Mobile Extensions Version

prop.name: VS_NO_COMPILE_BATCHING
prop.desc: Turn off compile batching for the target. Usually MSBuild calls the compiler with multiple c/cpp files and compiler starts subprocesses for each file to make the build parallel. If you want compiler to be invoked with one file at a time set VS_NO_COMPILE_BATCHING to ON. If this flag is set MSBuild will call compiler with one c/cpp file at a time. Useful when you want to use tool that replaces the compiler, for example some build caching tool.

prop.name: VS_NO_SOLUTION_DEPLOY
prop.desc: Specify that the target should not be marked for deployment to a Windows CE or Windows Phone device in the generated Visual Studio solution.

prop.name: VS_PACKAGE_REFERENCES
prop.desc: Visual Studio package references for nuget.

prop.name: VS_PLATFORM_TOOLSET
prop.desc: Overrides the platform toolset used to build a target.

prop.name: VS_PROJECT_IMPORT
prop.desc: Visual Studio managed project imports

prop.name: VS_RESOURCE_GENERATOR
prop.desc: This property allows to specify the resource generator to be used on this file. It defaults to PublicResXFileCodeGenerator if not set.

prop.name: VS_SCC_AUXPATH
prop.desc: Visual Studio Source Code Control Aux Path.

prop.name: VS_SCC_LOCALPATH
prop.desc: Visual Studio Source Code Control Local Path.

prop.name: VS_SCC_PROJECTNAME
prop.desc: Visual Studio Source Code Control Project.

prop.name: VS_SCC_PROVIDER
prop.desc: Visual Studio Source Code Control Provider.

prop.name: VS_SDK_REFERENCES
prop.desc: Visual Studio project SDK references. Specify a semicolon-separated list of SDK references to be added to a generated Visual Studio project, e.g. Microsoft.AdMediatorWindows81, Version=1.0.

prop.name: VS_SETTINGS
prop.desc: Add arbitrary MSBuild item metadata to a file.

prop.name: VS_SHADER_DISABLE_OPTIMIZATIONS
prop.desc: Disable compiler optimizations for an .hlsl source file. This adds the -Od flag to the command line for the FxCompiler tool. Specify the value true for this property to disable compiler optimizations.

prop.name: VS_SHADER_ENABLE_DEBUG
prop.desc: Enable debugging information for an .hlsl source file. This adds the -Zi flag to the command line for the FxCompiler tool. Specify the value true to generate debugging information for the compiled shader.

prop.name: VS_SHADER_ENTRYPOINT
prop.desc: Specifies the name of the entry point for the shader of a .hlsl source file.

prop.name: VS_SHADER_FLAGS
prop.desc: Set additional Visual Studio shader flags of a .hlsl source file.

prop.name: VS_SHADER_MODEL
prop.desc: Specifies the shader model of a .hlsl source file. Some shader types can only be used with recent shader models

prop.name: VS_SHADER_OBJECT_FILE_NAME
prop.desc: Specifies a file name for the compiled shader object file for an .hlsl source file. This adds the -Fo flag to the command line for the FxCompiler tool.

prop.name: VS_SHADER_OUTPUT_HEADER_FILE
prop.desc: Set filename for output header file containing object code of a .hlsl source file.

prop.name: VS_SHADER_TYPE
prop.desc: Set the Visual Studio shader type of a .hlsl source file.

prop.name: VS_SHADER_VARIABLE_NAME
prop.desc: Set name of variable in header file containing object code of a .hlsl source file.

prop.name: VS_SOLUTION_DEPLOY
prop.desc: Specify that the target should be marked for deployment when not targeting Windows CE, Windows Phone or a Windows Store application.

prop.name: VS_SOLUTION_ITEMS
prop.desc: Specify solution level items included in the generated Visual Studio solution.

prop.name: VS_SOURCE_SETTINGS_<tool>
prop.desc: Set any item metadata on all non-built files that use <tool>.

prop.name: VS_STARTUP_PROJECT
prop.desc: Specify the default startup project in a Visual Studio solution.

prop.name: VS_TOOL_OVERRIDE
prop.desc: Override the MSBuild item type of a source file in a Visual Studio project.

prop.name: VS_USER_PROPS
prop.desc: Sets the user props file to be included in the visual studio C++ project file. The standard path is $(UserRootDir)\\Microsoft.Cpp.$(Platform).user.props, which is in most cases the same as %LOCALAPPDATA%\\Microsoft\\MSBuild\\v4.0\\Microsoft.Cpp.Win32.user.props or %LOCALAPPDATA%\\Microsoft\\MSBuild\\v4.0\\Microsoft.Cpp.x64.user.props.

prop.name: VS_USE_DEBUG_LIBRARIES
prop.desc: Indicate to Visual Studio Generators what configurations are considered debug configurations. This controls the UseDebugLibraries setting in each configuration of a .vcxproj file.

prop.name: VS_WINDOWS_TARGET_PLATFORM_MIN_VERSION
prop.desc: Visual Studio Windows Target Platform Minimum Version

prop.name: VS_WINRT_COMPONENT
prop.desc: Mark a target as a Windows Runtime component for the Visual Studio Generators. Compile the target with C++/CX language extensions for Windows Runtime. For SHARED and MODULE libraries, this also defines the _WINRT_DLL preprocessor macro.

prop.name: VS_WINRT_EXTENSIONS
prop.desc: Deprecated. Use VS_WINRT_COMPONENT instead. This property was an experimental partial implementation of that one.

prop.name: VS_WINRT_REFERENCES
prop.desc: Visual Studio project Windows Runtime Metadata references

prop.name: VS_XAML_TYPE
prop.desc: Mark a Extensible Application Markup Language (XAML) source file as a different type than the default Page. The most common usage would be to set the default App.xaml file as ApplicationDefinition.

prop.name: WATCOM_RUNTIME_LIBRARY
prop.desc: Select the Watcom runtime library for use by compilers targeting the Watcom ABI.

prop.name: WILL_FAIL
prop.desc: If true, inverts the pass / fail test criteria. Tests for which WILL_FAIL is true fail with return code 0 and pass with non-zero return code. Tests that exceed the timeout specified by TIMEOUT still fail regardless of WILL_FAIL. System-level test failures including segmentation faults, signal abort, or heap errors may fail the test even if WILL_FAIL is true.

prop.name: WIN32_EXECUTABLE
prop.desc: Build an executable with a WinMain entry point on windows.

prop.name: WINDOWS_EXPORT_ALL_SYMBOLS
prop.desc: This property is implemented only for MS-compatible tools on Windows.

prop.name: WORKING_DIRECTORY
prop.desc: The directory from which the test executable will be called.

prop.name: WRAP_EXCLUDE
prop.desc: Exclude this source file from any code wrapping techniques.

prop.name: XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_<an-attribute>
prop.desc: Set Xcode target attributes directly.

prop.name: XCODE_EMBED_<type>
prop.desc: Tell the Xcode generator to embed the specified list of items into the target bundle. <type> specifies the embed build phase to use. See the Xcode documentation for the base location of each <type>.

prop.name: XCODE_EMBED_<type>_CODE_SIGN_ON_COPY
prop.desc: Boolean property used only by the Xcode generator. It specifies whether to perform code signing for the items that are embedded using the XCODE_EMBED_<type> property.

prop.name: XCODE_EMBED_<type>_PATH
prop.desc: This property is used only by the Xcode generator. When defined, it specifies the relative path to use when embedding the items specified by XCODE_EMBED_<type>. The path is relative to the base location of the Embed XXX build phase associated with <type>. See the Xcode documentation for the base location of each <type>.

prop.name: XCODE_EMBED_<type>_REMOVE_HEADERS_ON_COPY
prop.desc: Boolean property used only by the Xcode generator. It specifies whether to remove headers from all the frameworks that are embedded using the XCODE_EMBED_<type> property.

prop.name: XCODE_EMBED_FRAMEWORKS_CODE_SIGN_ON_COPY
prop.desc: Tell the Xcode generator to perform code signing for all the frameworks and libraries that are embedded using the XCODE_EMBED_FRAMEWORKS property.

prop.name: XCODE_EMBED_FRAMEWORKS_REMOVE_HEADERS_ON_COPY
prop.desc: Tell the Xcode generator to remove headers from all the frameworks that are embedded using the XCODE_EMBED_FRAMEWORKS property.

prop.name: XCODE_EMIT_EFFECTIVE_PLATFORM_NAME
prop.desc: Control emission of EFFECTIVE_PLATFORM_NAME by the Xcode generator.

prop.name: XCODE_EXPLICIT_FILE_TYPE
prop.desc: Set the Xcode explicitFileType attribute on its reference to a target. CMake computes a default based on target type but can be told explicitly with this property.

prop.name: XCODE_FILE_ATTRIBUTES
prop.desc: Add values to the Xcode ATTRIBUTES setting on its reference to a source file. Among other things, this can be used to set the role on a .mig file:

prop.name: XCODE_GENERATE_SCHEME
prop.desc: If enabled, the Xcode generator will generate schema files. These are useful to invoke analyze, archive, build-for-testing and test actions from the command line.

prop.name: XCODE_LAST_KNOWN_FILE_TYPE
prop.desc: Set the Xcode lastKnownFileType attribute on its reference to a source file. CMake computes a default based on file extension but can be told explicitly with this property.

prop.name: XCODE_LINK_BUILD_PHASE_MODE
prop.desc: When using the Xcode generator, libraries to be linked will be specified in the Xcode project file using either the "Link Binary With Libraries" build phase or directly as linker flags. The former allows Xcode to manage build paths, which may be necessary when creating Xcode archives because it may use different build paths to a regular build.

prop.name: XCODE_PRODUCT_TYPE
prop.desc: Set the Xcode productType attribute on its reference to a target. CMake computes a default based on target type but can be told explicitly with this property.

prop.name: XCODE_SCHEME_ADDRESS_SANITIZER
prop.desc: Whether to enable Address Sanitizer in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

prop.name: XCODE_SCHEME_ADDRESS_SANITIZER_USE_AFTER_RETURN
prop.desc: Whether to enable Detect use of stack after return in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

prop.name: XCODE_SCHEME_ARGUMENTS
prop.desc: Specify command line arguments that should be added to the Arguments section of the generated Xcode scheme.

prop.name: XCODE_SCHEME_DEBUG_AS_ROOT
prop.desc: Whether to debug the target as 'root'.

prop.name: XCODE_SCHEME_DEBUG_DOCUMENT_VERSIONING
prop.desc: Whether to enable Allow debugging when using document Versions Browser in the Options section of the generated Xcode scheme.

prop.name: XCODE_SCHEME_DISABLE_MAIN_THREAD_CHECKER
prop.desc: Whether to disable the Main Thread Checker in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

prop.name: XCODE_SCHEME_DYNAMIC_LIBRARY_LOADS
prop.desc: Whether to enable Dynamic Library Loads in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

prop.name: XCODE_SCHEME_DYNAMIC_LINKER_API_USAGE
prop.desc: Whether to enable Dynamic Linker API usage in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

prop.name: XCODE_SCHEME_ENABLE_GPU_API_VALIDATION
prop.desc: Property value for Metal: API Validation in the Options section of the generated Xcode scheme.

prop.name: XCODE_SCHEME_ENABLE_GPU_FRAME_CAPTURE_MODE
prop.desc: Property value for GPU Frame Capture in the Options section of the generated Xcode scheme. Example values are Metal and Disabled.

prop.name: XCODE_SCHEME_ENABLE_GPU_SHADER_VALIDATION
prop.desc: Property value for Metal: Shader Validation in the Options section of the generated Xcode scheme.

prop.name: XCODE_SCHEME_ENVIRONMENT
prop.desc: Specify environment variables that should be added to the Arguments section of the generated Xcode scheme.

prop.name: XCODE_SCHEME_EXECUTABLE
prop.desc: Specify path to executable in the Info section of the generated Xcode scheme. If not set the schema generator will select the current target if it is actually executable.

prop.name: XCODE_SCHEME_GUARD_MALLOC
prop.desc: Whether to enable Guard Malloc in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

prop.name: XCODE_SCHEME_LAUNCH_CONFIGURATION
prop.desc: Set the build configuration to run the target.

prop.name: XCODE_SCHEME_LAUNCH_MODE
prop.desc: Property value for Launch in the Info section of the generated Xcode scheme.

prop.name: XCODE_SCHEME_LLDB_INIT_FILE
prop.desc: Property value for LLDB Init File in the Info section of the generated Xcode scheme. In case the value contains generator expressions those are evaluated.

prop.name: XCODE_SCHEME_MAIN_THREAD_CHECKER_STOP
prop.desc: Whether to enable the Main Thread Checker option Pause on issues in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

prop.name: XCODE_SCHEME_MALLOC_GUARD_EDGES
prop.desc: Whether to enable Malloc Guard Edges in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

prop.name: XCODE_SCHEME_MALLOC_SCRIBBLE
prop.desc: Whether to enable Malloc Scribble in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

prop.name: XCODE_SCHEME_MALLOC_STACK
prop.desc: Whether to enable Malloc Stack in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

prop.name: XCODE_SCHEME_TEST_CONFIGURATION
prop.desc: Set the build configuration to test the target.

prop.name: XCODE_SCHEME_THREAD_SANITIZER
prop.desc: Whether to enable Thread Sanitizer in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

prop.name: XCODE_SCHEME_THREAD_SANITIZER_STOP
prop.desc: Whether to enable Thread Sanitizer - Pause on issues in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

prop.name: XCODE_SCHEME_UNDEFINED_BEHAVIOUR_SANITIZER
prop.desc: Whether to enable Undefined Behavior Sanitizer in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

prop.name: XCODE_SCHEME_UNDEFINED_BEHAVIOUR_SANITIZER_STOP
prop.desc: Whether to enable Undefined Behavior Sanitizer option Pause on issues in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

prop.name: XCODE_SCHEME_WORKING_DIRECTORY
prop.desc: Specify the Working Directory of the Run and Profile actions in the generated Xcode scheme. In case the value contains generator expressions those are evaluated.

prop.name: XCODE_SCHEME_ZOMBIE_OBJECTS
prop.desc: Whether to enable Zombie Objects in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

prop.name: XCODE_XCCONFIG
prop.desc: If set, the Xcode generator will register the specified file as a target-level XCConfig file. For global XCConfig files see the CMAKE_XCODE_XCCONFIG variable.

prop.name: XCTEST
prop.desc: Boolean target property that indicates whether a target is an XCTest CFBundle (Core Foundation Bundle) on Apple systems.

var.name: <PROJECT-NAME>_BINARY_DIR
var.desc: Top level binary directory for the named project.

var.name: <PROJECT-NAME>_COMPAT_VERSION
var.desc: Value given to the COMPAT_VERSION option of the most recent call to the project() command with project name <PROJECT-NAME>, if any.

var.name: <PROJECT-NAME>_DESCRIPTION
var.desc: Value given to the DESCRIPTION option of the most recent call to the project() command with project name <PROJECT-NAME>, if any.

var.name: <PROJECT-NAME>_HOMEPAGE_URL
var.desc: Value given to the HOMEPAGE_URL option of the most recent call to the project() command with project name <PROJECT-NAME>, if any.

var.name: <PROJECT-NAME>_IS_TOP_LEVEL
var.desc: A boolean variable indicating whether the named project was called in a top level CMakeLists.txt file.

var.name: <PROJECT-NAME>_SOURCE_DIR
var.desc: Top level source directory for the named project.

var.name: <PROJECT-NAME>_SPDX_LICENSE
var.desc: Value given to the SPDX_LICENSE option of the most recent call to the project() command with project name <PROJECT-NAME>, if any.

var.name: <PROJECT-NAME>_VERSION
var.desc: Value given to the VERSION option of the most recent call to the project() command with project name <PROJECT-NAME>, if any.

var.name: <PROJECT-NAME>_VERSION_MAJOR
var.desc: First version number component of the <PROJECT-NAME>_VERSION variable as set by the project() command.

var.name: <PROJECT-NAME>_VERSION_MINOR
var.desc: Second version number component of the <PROJECT-NAME>_VERSION variable as set by the project() command.

var.name: <PROJECT-NAME>_VERSION_PATCH
var.desc: Third version number component of the <PROJECT-NAME>_VERSION variable as set by the project() command.

var.name: <PROJECT-NAME>_VERSION_TWEAK
var.desc: Fourth version number component of the <PROJECT-NAME>_VERSION variable as set by the project() command.

var.name: <PackageName>_ROOT
var.desc: Calls to find_package(<PackageName>) will search in prefixes specified by the <PackageName>_ROOT CMake variable, where <PackageName> is the (case-preserved) name given to the find_package() call and _ROOT is literal. For example, find_package(Foo) will search prefixes specified in the Foo_ROOT CMake variable (if set). See policy CMP0074.

var.name: AIX
var.desc: Set to true when the target system is AIX.

var.name: ANDROID
var.desc: Set to 1 when the target system (CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME) is Android.

var.name: APPLE
var.desc: Set to True when the target system is an Apple platform (macOS, iOS, tvOS, visionOS or watchOS).

var.name: BORLAND
var.desc: True if the Borland compiler is being used.

var.name: BSD
var.desc: Set to a string value when the target system is BSD. This value can be one of the following: DragonFlyBSD, FreeBSD, OpenBSD, or NetBSD.

var.name: BUILD_SHARED_LIBS
var.desc: Tell add_library() to default to SHARED libraries, instead of STATIC libraries, when called with no explicit library type.

var.name: BUILD_TESTING
var.desc: Control whether the CTest module invokes enable_testing().

var.name: CACHE
var.desc: Operator to read cache variables.

var.name: CMAKE_<CONFIG>_POSTFIX
var.desc: Default filename postfix for libraries under configuration <CONFIG>.

var.name: CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG>
var.desc: Language-wide flags for language <LANG> used when building for the <CONFIG> configuration. These flags will be passed to all invocations of the compiler in the corresponding configuration. This includes invocations that drive compiling and those that drive linking.

var.name: CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG>_INIT
var.desc: Value used to initialize the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG> cache entry the first time a build tree is configured for language <LANG>. This variable is meant to be set by a toolchain file. CMake may prepend or append content to the value based on the environment and target platform.

var.name: CMAKE_<LANG>_LINK_GROUP_USING_<FEATURE>
var.desc: This variable defines how to link a group of libraries for the specified <FEATURE> when a LINK_GROUP generator expression is used and the link language for the target is <LANG>. For this variable to have any effect, the associated CMAKE_<LANG>_LINK_GROUP_USING_<FEATURE>_SUPPORTED variable must be set to true.

var.name: CMAKE_<LANG>_LINK_GROUP_USING_<FEATURE>_SUPPORTED
var.desc: This variable specifies whether the <FEATURE> is supported for the link language <LANG>. If this variable is true, then the <FEATURE> must be defined by CMAKE_<LANG>_LINK_GROUP_USING_<FEATURE>, and the more generic CMAKE_LINK_GROUP_USING_<FEATURE>_SUPPORTED and CMAKE_LINK_GROUP_USING_<FEATURE> variables are not used.

var.name: CMAKE_<LANG>_LINK_LIBRARY_<FEATURE>_ATTRIBUTES
var.desc: This variable defines the semantics of the specified link library <FEATURE> when linking with the link language <LANG>. It takes precedence over CMAKE_LINK_LIBRARY_<FEATURE>_ATTRIBUTES if that variable is also defined for the same <FEATURE>, but otherwise has similar effects. See CMAKE_LINK_LIBRARY_<FEATURE>_ATTRIBUTES for further details.

var.name: CMAKE_<LANG>_LINK_LIBRARY_USING_<FEATURE>
var.desc: This variable defines how to link a library or framework for the specified <FEATURE> when a LINK_LIBRARY generator expression is used and the link language for the target is <LANG>. For this variable to have any effect, the associated CMAKE_<LANG>_LINK_LIBRARY_USING_<FEATURE>_SUPPORTED variable must be set to true.

var.name: CMAKE_<LANG>_LINK_LIBRARY_USING_<FEATURE>_SUPPORTED
var.desc: Set to TRUE if the <FEATURE>, as defined by variable CMAKE_<LANG>_LINK_LIBRARY_USING_<FEATURE>, is supported for the linker language <LANG>.

var.name: CMAKE_<LANG>_USING_LINKER_<TYPE>
var.desc: This variable defines how to specify the <TYPE> linker for the link step, as controlled by the CMAKE_LINKER_TYPE variable or the LINKER_TYPE target property. Depending on the value of the CMAKE_<LANG>_LINK_MODE variable, CMAKE_<LANG>_USING_LINKER_<TYPE> can hold compiler flags for the link step, or the path to the linker tool.

var.name: CMAKE_ABSOLUTE_DESTINATION_FILES
var.desc: List of files which have been installed using an ABSOLUTE DESTINATION path.

var.name: CMAKE_ADD_CUSTOM_COMMAND_DEPENDS_EXPLICIT_ONLY
var.desc: Whether to enable the DEPENDS_EXPLICIT_ONLY option by default in add_custom_command().

var.name: CMAKE_ADSP_ROOT
var.desc: When Cross Compiling for ADSP SHARC/Blackfin, this variable holds the absolute path to the latest CCES or VDSP++ install. The directory is expected to contain the cc21k.exe and ccblkfn.exe compilers. This will be set automatically if a default install of CCES or VDSP++ can be found.

var.name: CMAKE_AIX_EXPORT_ALL_SYMBOLS
var.desc: Default value for AIX_EXPORT_ALL_SYMBOLS target property. This variable is used to initialize the property on each target as it is created.

var.name: CMAKE_AIX_SHARED_LIBRARY_ARCHIVE
var.desc: On AIX, enable or disable creation of shared library archives.

var.name: CMAKE_ANDROID_ANT_ADDITIONAL_OPTIONS
var.desc: Default value for the ANDROID_ANT_ADDITIONAL_OPTIONS target property. See that target property for additional information.

var.name: CMAKE_ANDROID_API
var.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android with NVIDIA Nsight Tegra Visual Studio Edition, this variable may be set to specify the default value for the ANDROID_API target property. See that target property for additional information.

var.name: CMAKE_ANDROID_API_MIN
var.desc: Default value for the ANDROID_API_MIN target property. See that target property for additional information.

var.name: CMAKE_ANDROID_ARCH
var.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android with NVIDIA Nsight Tegra Visual Studio Edition, this variable may be set to specify the default value for the ANDROID_ARCH target property. See that target property for additional information.

var.name: CMAKE_ANDROID_ARCH_ABI
var.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android, this variable specifies the target architecture and ABI to be used. Valid values are:

var.name: CMAKE_ANDROID_ARM_MODE
var.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android and CMAKE_ANDROID_ARCH_ABI is set to one of the armeabi architectures, set CMAKE_ANDROID_ARM_MODE to ON to target 32-bit ARM processors (-marm). Otherwise, the default is to target the 16-bit Thumb processors (-mthumb).

var.name: CMAKE_ANDROID_ARM_NEON
var.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android and CMAKE_ANDROID_ARCH_ABI is set to armeabi-v7a set CMAKE_ANDROID_ARM_NEON to ON to target ARM NEON devices.

var.name: CMAKE_ANDROID_ASSETS_DIRECTORIES
var.desc: Default value for the ANDROID_ASSETS_DIRECTORIES target property. See that target property for additional information.

var.name: CMAKE_ANDROID_EXCEPTIONS
var.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android with the NDK, this variable may be set to specify whether exceptions are enabled.

var.name: CMAKE_ANDROID_GUI
var.desc: Default value for the ANDROID_GUI target property of executables. See that target property for additional information.

var.name: CMAKE_ANDROID_JAR_DEPENDENCIES
var.desc: Default value for the ANDROID_JAR_DEPENDENCIES target property. See that target property for additional information.

var.name: CMAKE_ANDROID_JAR_DIRECTORIES
var.desc: Default value for the ANDROID_JAR_DIRECTORIES target property. See that target property for additional information.

var.name: CMAKE_ANDROID_JAVA_SOURCE_DIR
var.desc: Default value for the ANDROID_JAVA_SOURCE_DIR target property. See that target property for additional information.

var.name: CMAKE_ANDROID_NATIVE_LIB_DEPENDENCIES
var.desc: Default value for the ANDROID_NATIVE_LIB_DEPENDENCIES target property. See that target property for additional information.

var.name: CMAKE_ANDROID_NATIVE_LIB_DIRECTORIES
var.desc: Default value for the ANDROID_NATIVE_LIB_DIRECTORIES target property. See that target property for additional information.

var.name: CMAKE_ANDROID_NDK
var.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android with the NDK, this variable holds the absolute path to the root directory of the NDK. The directory must contain a platforms subdirectory holding the android-<api> directories.

var.name: CMAKE_ANDROID_NDK_DEPRECATED_HEADERS
var.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android with the NDK, this variable may be set to specify whether to use the deprecated per-api-level headers instead of the unified headers.

var.name: CMAKE_ANDROID_NDK_TOOLCHAIN_HOST_TAG
var.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android with the NDK, this variable provides the NDK's "host tag" used to construct the path to prebuilt toolchains that run on the host.

var.name: CMAKE_ANDROID_NDK_TOOLCHAIN_VERSION
var.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android with the NDK, this variable may be set to specify the version of the toolchain to be used as the compiler.

var.name: CMAKE_ANDROID_NDK_VERSION
var.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android with the NDK and using an Android NDK version 11 or higher, this variable is provided by CMake to report the NDK version number.

var.name: CMAKE_ANDROID_PROCESS_MAX
var.desc: Default value for the ANDROID_PROCESS_MAX target property. See that target property for additional information.

var.name: CMAKE_ANDROID_PROGUARD
var.desc: Default value for the ANDROID_PROGUARD target property. See that target property for additional information.

var.name: CMAKE_ANDROID_PROGUARD_CONFIG_PATH
var.desc: Default value for the ANDROID_PROGUARD_CONFIG_PATH target property. See that target property for additional information.

var.name: CMAKE_ANDROID_RTTI
var.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android with the NDK, this variable may be set to specify whether RTTI is enabled.

var.name: CMAKE_ANDROID_SECURE_PROPS_PATH
var.desc: Default value for the ANDROID_SECURE_PROPS_PATH target property. See that target property for additional information.

var.name: CMAKE_ANDROID_SKIP_ANT_STEP
var.desc: Default value for the ANDROID_SKIP_ANT_STEP target property. See that target property for additional information.

var.name: CMAKE_ANDROID_STANDALONE_TOOLCHAIN
var.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android with a Standalone Toolchain, this variable holds the absolute path to the root directory of the toolchain. The specified directory must contain a sysroot subdirectory.

var.name: CMAKE_ANDROID_STL_TYPE
var.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android with NVIDIA Nsight Tegra Visual Studio Edition, this variable may be set to specify the default value for the ANDROID_STL_TYPE target property. See that target property for additional information.

var.name: CMAKE_APPBUNDLE_PATH
var.desc: Semicolon-separated list of directories specifying a search path for macOS application bundles used by the find_program(), and find_package() commands.

var.name: CMAKE_APPLE_SILICON_PROCESSOR
var.desc: On Apple Silicon hosts running macOS, set this variable to tell CMake what architecture to use for CMAKE_HOST_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR. The value must be either arm64 or x86_64.

var.name: CMAKE_AR
var.desc: Name of archiving tool for static libraries.

var.name: CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
var.desc: Where to put all the ARCHIVE target files when built.

var.name: CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_<CONFIG>
var.desc: Where to put all the ARCHIVE target files when built for a specific configuration.

var.name: CMAKE_ARGC
var.desc: Number of command line arguments passed to CMake in script mode.

var.name: CMAKE_ARGV0
var.desc: Command line argument passed to CMake in script mode.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_ANDROID_TOOLCHAIN_MACHINE
var.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android this variable contains the toolchain binutils machine name (e.g. gcc -dumpmachine). The binutils typically have a <machine>- prefix on their name.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_ANDROID_TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX
var.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android this variable contains the absolute path prefixing the toolchain GNU compiler and its binutils.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_ANDROID_TOOLCHAIN_SUFFIX
var.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android this variable contains the host platform suffix of the toolchain GNU compiler and its binutils.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_ARCHIVER_WRAPPER_FLAG
var.desc: Defines the syntax of compiler driver option to pass options to the archiver tool. It will be used to translate the ARCHIVER: prefix in the static library options (see STATIC_LIBRARY_OPTIONS).

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_ARCHIVER_WRAPPER_FLAG_SEP
var.desc: This variable is used with CMAKE_<LANG>_ARCHIVER_WRAPPER_FLAG variable to format ARCHIVER: prefix in the static library options (see STATIC_LIBRARY_OPTIONS).

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_ARCHIVE_APPEND
var.desc: Rule variable to append to a static archive.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_ARCHIVE_CREATE
var.desc: Rule variable to create a new static archive.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_ARCHIVE_FINISH
var.desc: Rule variable to finish an existing static archive.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_BYTE_ORDER
var.desc: Byte order of <LANG> compiler target architecture, if known. If defined and not empty, the value is one of:

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_CLANG_TIDY
var.desc: Default value for <LANG>_CLANG_TIDY target property when <LANG> is C, CXX, OBJC or OBJCXX.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_CLANG_TIDY_EXPORT_FIXES_DIR
var.desc: Default value for <LANG>_CLANG_TIDY_EXPORT_FIXES_DIR target property when <LANG> is C, CXX, OBJC or OBJCXX.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_COMPILER
var.desc: The full path to the compiler for LANG.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_COMPILER_ABI
var.desc: An internal variable subject to change.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_COMPILER_AR
var.desc: A wrapper around ar adding the appropriate --plugin option for the compiler.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_COMPILER_ARCHITECTURE_ID
var.desc: List of identifiers indicating the target architecture(s) of the compiler for language <LANG>.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_COMPILER_EXTERNAL_TOOLCHAIN
var.desc: The external toolchain for cross-compiling, if supported.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT
var.desc: Identification string of the compiler frontend variant.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_COMPILER_ID
var.desc: Compiler identification string.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_COMPILER_LAUNCHER
var.desc: Default value for <LANG>_COMPILER_LAUNCHER target property. This variable is used to initialize the property on each target as it is created. This is done only when <LANG> is C, CXX, Fortran, HIP, ISPC, OBJC, OBJCXX, or CUDA.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_COMPILER_LINKER
var.desc: The full path to the linker for LANG.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_COMPILER_LINKER_FRONTEND_VARIANT
var.desc: Identification string of the linker frontend variant.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_FLAGS
var.desc: Language-wide flags for language <LANG> used when building for all configurations. These flags will be passed to all invocations of the compiler. This includes invocations that drive compiling and those that drive linking.

var.desc: Language-wide flags for language <LANG> used when building for the <CONFIG> configuration. These flags will be passed to all invocations of the compiler in the corresponding configuration. This includes invocations that drive compiling and those that drive linking.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_FLAGS
var.desc: Value used to initialize the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG> cache entry the first time a build tree is configured for language <LANG>. This variable is meant to be set by a toolchain file. CMake may prepend or append content to the value based on the environment and target platform.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_FLAGS_DEBUG
var.desc: This variable is the Debug variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG> variable.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_FLAGS_DEBUG_INIT

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_FLAGS_INIT
var.desc: Value used to initialize the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS cache entry the first time a build tree is configured for language <LANG>. This variable is meant to be set by a toolchain file. CMake may prepend or append content to the value based on the environment and target platform. For example, the contents of a xxxFLAGS environment variable will be prepended, where xxx will be language-specific but not necessarily the same as <LANG> (e.g. CXXFLAGS for CXX, FFLAGS for Fortran, and so on). This value is a command-line string fragment. Therefore, multiple options should be separated by spaces, and options with spaces should be quoted.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_LINK_GROUP_USING
var.desc: This variable defines how to link a group of libraries for the specified <FEATURE> when a LINK_GROUP generator expression is used and the link language for the target is <LANG>. For this variable to have any effect, the associated CMAKE_<LANG>_LINK_GROUP_USING_<FEATURE>_SUPPORTED variable must be set to true.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_LINK_GROUP_USING
var.desc: This variable specifies whether the <FEATURE> is supported for the link language <LANG>. If this variable is true, then the <FEATURE> must be defined by CMAKE_<LANG>_LINK_GROUP_USING_<FEATURE>, and the more generic CMAKE_LINK_GROUP_USING_<FEATURE>_SUPPORTED and CMAKE_LINK_GROUP_USING_<FEATURE> variables are not used.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM-ATT_LINK_LIBRARY

It takes precedence over CMAKE_LINK_LIBRARY_<FEATURE>_ATTRIBUTES if that variable is also defined for the same <FEATURE>, but otherwise has similar effects. See CMAKE_LINK_LIBRARY_<FEATURE>_ATTRIBUTES for further details.
