Its value will be set to one of the supported values of the corresponding <LANG>_STANDARD target property; see the documentation of that property for a list of supported languages.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM_STANDARD_LIBRARIES
var.desc: Libraries linked into every executable and shared library linked for language <LANG>. This is meant for specification of system libraries needed by the language for the current platform.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM_STANDARD_LINK_DIRECTORIES
var.desc: Link directories specified for every executable and library linked for language <LANG>. This is meant for specification of system link directories needed by the language for the current platform.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM_STANDARD_REQUIRED
var.desc: The variations are:

var.name: CMAKE_ASM_USING_LINKER
var.desc: This variable defines how to specify the <TYPE> linker for the link step, as controlled by the CMAKE_LINKER_TYPE variable or the LINKER_TYPE target property. Depending on the value of the CMAKE_<LANG>_LINK_MODE variable, CMAKE_<LANG>_USING_LINKER_<TYPE> can hold compiler flags for the link step, or the path to the linker tool.

var.name: CMAKE_ASM_USING_LINKER_MODE
var.desc: This variable controls how the value of the CMAKE_<LANG>_USING_LINKER_<TYPE> variable should be interpreted. The supported linker mode values are:

var.name: CMAKE_ASM_VISIBILITY_PRESET
var.desc: Default value for the <LANG>_VISIBILITY_PRESET target property when a target is created.

var.name: CMAKE_AUTOGEN_BETTER_GRAPH_MULTI_CONFIG
var.desc: This variable is used to initialize the AUTOGEN_BETTER_GRAPH_MULTI_CONFIG property on all targets as they are created. See that target property for additional information.

var.name: CMAKE_AUTOGEN_COMMAND_LINE_LENGTH_MAX
var.desc: Command line length limit for autogen targets, i.e. moc or uic, that triggers the use of response files on Windows instead of passing all arguments to the command line.

var.name: CMAKE_AUTOGEN_INTERMEDIATE_DIR_STRATEGY
var.desc: CMAKE_AUTOGEN_INTERMEDIATE_DIR_STRATEGY is a string cache variable specifying the strategy to use for autogen target intermediate directories and their contents. The supported values are:

var.name: CMAKE_AUTOGEN_ORIGIN_DEPENDS
var.desc: Switch for forwarding origin target dependencies to the corresponding <ORIGIN>_autogen targets.

var.name: CMAKE_AUTOGEN_PARALLEL
var.desc: Number of parallel moc or uic processes to start when using AUTOMOC and AUTOUIC.

var.name: CMAKE_AUTOGEN_USE_SYSTEM_INCLUDE
var.desc: This variable is used to initialize the AUTOGEN_USE_SYSTEM_INCLUDE property on all targets as they are created. See that target property for additional information.

var.name: CMAKE_AUTOGEN_VERBOSE
var.desc: Sets the verbosity of AUTOMOC, AUTOUIC and AUTORCC. A positive integer value or a true boolean value lets the AUTO* generators output additional processing information.

var.name: CMAKE_AUTOMOC
var.desc: Whether to handle moc automatically for Qt targets.

var.name: CMAKE_AUTOMOC_COMPILER_PREDEFINES
var.desc: This variable is used to initialize the AUTOMOC_COMPILER_PREDEFINES property on all the targets. See that target property for additional information.

var.name: CMAKE_AUTOMOC_DEPEND_FILTERS
var.desc: Filter definitions used by CMAKE_AUTOMOC to extract file names from source code as additional dependencies for the moc file.

var.name: CMAKE_AUTOMOC_EXECUTABLE
var.desc: This variable is used to initialize the AUTOMOC_EXECUTABLE property on all the targets. See that target property for additional information.

var.name: CMAKE_AUTOMOC_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES
var.desc: Specifies zero or more include directories for AUTOMOC to pass explicitly to the Qt Meta‑Object Compiler (moc) instead of automatically discovering each target's include directories.

var.name: CMAKE_AUTOMOC_MACRO_NAMES
var.desc: Semicolon-separated list list of macro names used by CMAKE_AUTOMOC to determine if a C++ file needs to be processed by moc.

var.name: CMAKE_AUTOMOC_MOC_OPTIONS
var.desc: Additional options for moc when using CMAKE_AUTOMOC.

var.name: CMAKE_AUTOMOC_PATH_PREFIX
var.desc: Whether to generate the -p path prefix option for moc on AUTOMOC enabled Qt targets.

var.name: CMAKE_AUTOMOC_RELAXED_MODE
var.desc: Switch between strict and relaxed automoc mode.

var.name: CMAKE_AUTORCC
var.desc: Whether to handle rcc automatically for Qt targets.

var.name: CMAKE_AUTORCC_EXECUTABLE
var.desc: This variable is used to initialize the AUTORCC_EXECUTABLE property on all the targets. See that target property for additional information.

var.name: CMAKE_AUTORCC_OPTIONS
var.desc: Additional options for rcc when using CMAKE_AUTORCC.

var.name: CMAKE_AUTOUIC
var.desc: Whether to handle uic automatically for Qt targets.

var.name: CMAKE_AUTOUIC_EXECUTABLE
var.desc: This variable is used to initialize the AUTOUIC_EXECUTABLE property on all the targets. See that target property for additional information.

var.name: CMAKE_AUTOUIC_OPTIONS
var.desc: Additional options for uic when using CMAKE_AUTOUIC.

var.name: CMAKE_AUTOUIC_SEARCH_PATHS
var.desc: Search path list used by CMAKE_AUTOUIC to find included .ui files.

var.name: CMAKE_BACKWARDS_COMPATIBILITY
var.desc: Removed. See policy CMP0001.

var.name: CMAKE_BINARY_DIR
var.desc: The path to the top level of the build tree.

var.name: CMAKE_BUILD_RPATH
var.desc: Semicolon-separated list specifying runtime path (RPATH) entries to add to binaries linked in the build tree (for platforms that support it). The entries will not be used for binaries in the install tree. See also the CMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH variable.

var.name: CMAKE_BUILD_RPATH_USE_ORIGIN
var.desc: Whether to use relative paths for the build RPATH.

var.name: CMAKE_BUILD_TOOL
var.desc: This variable exists only for backwards compatibility. It contains the same value as CMAKE_MAKE_PROGRAM. Use that variable instead.

var.name: CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE
var.desc: Specifies the build type on single-configuration generators (e.g. Makefile Generators or Ninja). Typical values include Debug, Release, RelWithDebInfo and MinSizeRel, but custom build types can also be defined.

var.name: CMAKE_BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_NAME_DIR
var.desc: Whether to use INSTALL_NAME_DIR on targets in the build tree.

var.name: CMAKE_BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_RPATH
var.desc: Use the install path for the RPATH.

var.name: CMAKE_CACHEFILE_DIR
var.desc: This variable is used internally by CMake, and may not be set during the first configuration of a build tree. When it is set, it has the same value as CMAKE_BINARY_DIR. Use that variable instead.

var.name: CMAKE_CACHE_MAJOR_VERSION
var.desc: Major version of CMake used to create the CMakeCache.txt file

var.name: CMAKE_CACHE_MINOR_VERSION
var.desc: Minor version of CMake used to create the CMakeCache.txt file

var.name: CMAKE_CACHE_PATCH_VERSION
var.desc: Patch version of CMake used to create the CMakeCache.txt file

var.name: CMAKE_CFG_INTDIR
var.desc: Build-time reference to per-configuration output subdirectory.

var.name: CMAKE_CLANG_VFS_OVERLAY
var.desc: When cross compiling for windows with clang-cl, this variable can be an absolute path pointing to a clang virtual file system yaml file, which will enable clang-cl to resolve windows header names on a case sensitive file system.

var.name: CMAKE_CL_64
var.desc: Discouraged. Use CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P instead.

var.name: CMAKE_CODEBLOCKS_COMPILER_ID
var.desc: Change the compiler id in the generated CodeBlocks project files.

var.name: CMAKE_CODEBLOCKS_EXCLUDE_EXTERNAL_FILES
var.desc: Change the way the CodeBlocks generator creates project files.

var.name: CMAKE_CODELITE_USE_TARGETS
var.desc: Change the way the CodeLite generator creates projectfiles.

var.name: CMAKE_COLOR_DIAGNOSTICS
var.desc: Enable color diagnostics throughout the generated build system.

var.name: CMAKE_COLOR_MAKEFILE
var.desc: Enables color output when using the Makefile Generators.

var.name: CMAKE_COMMAND
var.desc: The full path to the cmake(1) executable.

var.name: CMAKE_COMPILER_2005
var.desc: Using the Visual Studio 2005 compiler from Microsoft

var.name: CMAKE_COMPILER_IS_GNUCC
var.desc: The CMAKE_COMPILER_IS_GNUCC variable is set to boolean true if the C compiler is GNU.

var.name: CMAKE_COMPILER_IS_GNUCXX
var.desc: The CMAKE_COMPILER_IS_GNUCXX variable is set to boolean true if the C++ (CXX) compiler is GNU.

var.name: CMAKE_COMPILER_IS_GNUG77
var.desc: The CMAKE_COMPILER_IS_GNUG77 variable is set to boolean true if the Fortran compiler is GNU.

var.name: CMAKE_COMPILE_PDB_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
var.desc: Output directory for MS debug symbol .pdb files generated by the compiler while building source files.

var.name: CMAKE_COMPILE_PDB_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_<CONFIG>
var.desc: Per-configuration output directory for MS debug symbol .pdb files generated by the compiler while building source files.

var.name: CMAKE_COMPILE_WARNING_AS_ERROR
var.desc: Specify whether to treat warnings on compile as errors.

var.name: CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES
var.desc: Specifies the available build types (configurations) on multi-config generators (e.g. Visual Studio, Xcode, or Ninja Multi-Config) as a semicolon-separated list. Typical entries include Debug, Release, RelWithDebInfo and MinSizeRel, but custom build types can also be defined.

var.name: CMAKE_CPACK_COMMAND
var.desc: Full path to cpack(1) command installed with CMake.

var.name: CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING
var.desc: This variable is set by CMake to indicate whether it is cross compiling, but note limitations discussed below.

var.name: CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR
var.desc: This variable is only used when CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING is on. It should point to a command on the host system that can run executable built for the target system.

var.name: CMAKE_CROSS_CONFIGS
var.desc: Specifies a semicolon-separated list of configurations available from all build-<Config>.ninja files in the Ninja Multi-Config generator. This variable activates cross-config mode. Targets from each config specified in this variable can be built from any build-<Config>.ninja file. Custom commands will use the configuration native to build-<Config>.ninja. If it is set to all, all configurations from CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES are cross-configs. If it is not specified, or empty, each build-<Config>.ninja file will only contain build rules for its own configuration.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_ANDROID_TOOLCHAIN_MACHINE
var.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android this variable contains the toolchain binutils machine name (e.g. gcc -dumpmachine). The binutils typically have a <machine>- prefix on their name.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_ANDROID_TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX
var.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android this variable contains the absolute path prefixing the toolchain GNU compiler and its binutils.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_ANDROID_TOOLCHAIN_SUFFIX
var.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android this variable contains the host platform suffix of the toolchain GNU compiler and its binutils.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_ARCHIVER_WRAPPER_FLAG
var.desc: Defines the syntax of compiler driver option to pass options to the archiver tool. It will be used to translate the ARCHIVER: prefix in the static library options (see STATIC_LIBRARY_OPTIONS).

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_ARCHIVER_WRAPPER_FLAG_SEP
var.desc: This variable is used with CMAKE_<LANG>_ARCHIVER_WRAPPER_FLAG variable to format ARCHIVER: prefix in the static library options (see STATIC_LIBRARY_OPTIONS).

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_ARCHIVE_APPEND
var.desc: Rule variable to append to a static archive.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_ARCHIVE_CREATE
var.desc: Rule variable to create a new static archive.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_ARCHIVE_FINISH
var.desc: Rule variable to finish an existing static archive.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_BYTE_ORDER
var.desc: Byte order of <LANG> compiler target architecture, if known. If defined and not empty, the value is one of:

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_CLANG_TIDY
var.desc: Default value for <LANG>_CLANG_TIDY target property when <LANG> is C, CXX, OBJC or OBJCXX.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_CLANG_TIDY_EXPORT_FIXES_DIR
var.desc: Default value for <LANG>_CLANG_TIDY_EXPORT_FIXES_DIR target property when <LANG> is C, CXX, OBJC or OBJCXX.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_COMPILER
var.desc: The full path to the compiler for LANG.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_COMPILER_ABI
var.desc: An internal variable subject to change.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_COMPILER_AR
var.desc: A wrapper around ar adding the appropriate --plugin option for the compiler.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_COMPILER_ARCHITECTURE_ID
var.desc: List of identifiers indicating the target architecture(s) of the compiler for language <LANG>.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_COMPILER_EXTERNAL_TOOLCHAIN
var.desc: The external toolchain for cross-compiling, if supported.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT
var.desc: Identification string of the compiler frontend variant.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_COMPILER_ID
var.desc: Compiler identification string.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_COMPILER_LAUNCHER
var.desc: Default value for <LANG>_COMPILER_LAUNCHER target property. This variable is used to initialize the property on each target as it is created. This is done only when <LANG> is C, CXX, Fortran, HIP, ISPC, OBJC, OBJCXX, or CUDA.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_COMPILER_LINKER
var.desc: The full path to the linker for LANG.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_COMPILER_LINKER_FRONTEND_VARIANT
var.desc: Identification string of the linker frontend variant.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_COMPILER_LINKER_ID
var.desc: Linker identification string.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_COMPILER_LINKER_VERSION
var.desc: Linker version string.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_COMPILER_LOADED
var.desc: Defined to true if the language is enabled.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_COMPILER_PREDEFINES_COMMAND
var.desc: Command that outputs the compiler pre definitions.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_COMPILER_RANLIB
var.desc: A wrapper around ranlib adding the appropriate --plugin option for the compiler.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_COMPILER_TARGET
var.desc: The target for cross-compiling, if supported.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_COMPILER_VERSION
var.desc: Compiler version string.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_COMPILER_VERSION_INTERNAL
var.desc: An internal variable subject to change.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_COMPILE_OBJECT
var.desc: Rule variable to compile a single object file.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_CPPCHECK
var.desc: Default value for <LANG>_CPPCHECK target property. This variable is used to initialize the property on each target as it is created. This is done only when <LANG> is C or CXX.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_CPPLINT
var.desc: Default value for <LANG>_CPPLINT target property. This variable is used to initialize the property on each target as it is created. This is done only when <LANG> is C or CXX.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_CREATE_SHARED_LIBRARY
var.desc: Rule variable to create a shared library.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_CREATE_SHARED_LIBRARY_ARCHIVE
var.desc: Rule variable to create a shared library with archive.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_CREATE_SHARED_MODULE
var.desc: Rule variable to create a shared module.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_CREATE_STATIC_LIBRARY
var.desc: Rule variable to create a static library.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_DEVICE_LINK_MODE
var.desc: Defines how the device link step is done. The possible values are:

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_EXTENSIONS
var.desc: The variations are:

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_EXTENSIONS_DEFAULT
var.desc: Compiler's default extensions mode. Used as the default for the <LANG>_EXTENSIONS target property when CMAKE_<LANG>_EXTENSIONS is not set (see CMP0128).

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_FLAGS
var.desc: Language-wide flags for language <LANG> used when building for all configurations. These flags will be passed to all invocations of the compiler. This includes invocations that drive compiling and those that drive linking.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_FLAGS
var.desc: Language-wide flags for language <LANG> used when building for the <CONFIG> configuration. These flags will be passed to all invocations of the compiler in the corresponding configuration. This includes invocations that drive compiling and those that drive linking.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_FLAGS
var.desc: Value used to initialize the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG> cache entry the first time a build tree is configured for language <LANG>. This variable is meant to be set by a toolchain file. CMake may prepend or append content to the value based on the environment and target platform.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_FLAGS_DEBUG
var.desc: This variable is the Debug variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG> variable.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_FLAGS_DEBUG_INIT
var.desc: This variable is the Debug variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG>_INIT variable.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_FLAGS_INIT
var.desc: Value used to initialize the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS cache entry the first time a build tree is configured for language <LANG>. This variable is meant to be set by a toolchain file. CMake may prepend or append content to the value based on the environment and target platform. For example, the contents of a xxxFLAGS environment variable will be prepended, where xxx will be language-specific but not necessarily the same as <LANG> (e.g. CXXFLAGS for CXX, FFLAGS for Fortran, and so on). This value is a command-line string fragment. Therefore, multiple options should be separated by spaces, and options with spaces should be quoted.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_FLAGS_MINSIZEREL
var.desc: This variable is the MinSizeRel variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG> variable.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_FLAGS_MINSIZEREL_INIT
var.desc: This variable is the MinSizeRel variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG>_INIT variable.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_FLAGS_RELEASE
var.desc: This variable is the Release variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG> variable.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_FLAGS_RELEASE_INIT
var.desc: This variable is the Release variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG>_INIT variable.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_FLAGS_RELWITHDEBINFO
var.desc: This variable is the RelWithDebInfo variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG> variable.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_FLAGS_RELWITHDEBINFO_INIT
var.desc: This variable is the RelWithDebInfo variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG>_INIT variable.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_HOST_COMPILER
var.desc: This variable is available when <LANG> is CUDA or HIP.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_HOST_COMPILER_ID
var.desc: This variable is available when <LANG> is CUDA or HIP and CMAKE_<LANG>_COMPILER_ID is NVIDIA. It contains the identity of the host compiler invoked by nvcc, either by default or as specified by CMAKE_<LANG>_HOST_COMPILER, among possibilities documented by CMAKE_<LANG>_COMPILER_ID.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_HOST_COMPILER_VERSION
var.desc: This variable is available when <LANG> is CUDA or HIP and CMAKE_<LANG>_COMPILER_ID is NVIDIA. It contains the version of the host compiler invoked by nvcc, either by default or as specified by CMAKE_<LANG>_HOST_COMPILER, in the same format as CMAKE_<LANG>_COMPILER_VERSION.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_ICSTAT
var.desc: Default value for <LANG>_ICSTAT target property. This variable is used to initialize the property on each target as it is created. This is done only when <LANG> is C or CXX.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_IGNORE_EXTENSIONS
var.desc: File extensions that should be ignored by the build.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_IMPLICIT_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES
var.desc: Directories implicitly searched by the compiler for header files.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_IMPLICIT_LINK_DIRECTORIES
var.desc: Implicit linker search path detected for language <LANG>.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_IMPLICIT_LINK_FRAMEWORK_DIRECTORIES
var.desc: Implicit linker framework search path detected for language <LANG>.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_IMPLICIT_LINK_LIBRARIES
var.desc: Implicit link libraries and flags detected for language <LANG>.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_INCLUDE_WHAT_YOU_USE
var.desc: Default value for <LANG>_INCLUDE_WHAT_YOU_USE target property. This variable is used to initialize the property on each target as it is created. This is done only when <LANG> is C or CXX.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_LIBRARY_ARCHITECTURE
var.desc: Target architecture library directory name detected for <LANG>.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_LINKER_LAUNCHER
var.desc: Default value for <LANG>_LINKER_LAUNCHER target property. This variable is used to initialize the property on each target as it is created. This is done only when <LANG> is one of:

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_LINKER_PREFERENCE
var.desc: An internal variable subject to change.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_LINKER_PREFERENCE_PROPAGATES
var.desc: An internal variable subject to change.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_LINKER_WRAPPER_FLAG
var.desc: Defines the syntax of compiler driver option to pass options to the linker tool. It will be used to translate the LINKER: prefix in the link options (see add_link_options() and target_link_options()).

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_LINKER_WRAPPER_FLAG_SEP
var.desc: This variable is used with CMAKE_<LANG>_LINKER_WRAPPER_FLAG variable to format LINKER: prefix in the link options (see add_link_options() and target_link_options()).

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_LINK_DEF_FILE_FLAG
var.desc: Linker flag to be used to specify a .def file for dll creation with the toolchain for language <LANG>.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_LINK_EXECUTABLE
var.desc: Rule variable to link an executable.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_LINK_GROUP_USING
var.desc: This variable defines how to link a group of libraries for the specified <FEATURE> when a LINK_GROUP generator expression is used and the link language for the target is <LANG>. For this variable to have any effect, the associated CMAKE_<LANG>_LINK_GROUP_USING_<FEATURE>_SUPPORTED variable must be set to true.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_LINK_GROUP_USING
var.desc: This variable specifies whether the <FEATURE> is supported for the link language <LANG>. If this variable is true, then the <FEATURE> must be defined by CMAKE_<LANG>_LINK_GROUP_USING_<FEATURE>, and the more generic CMAKE_LINK_GROUP_USING_<FEATURE>_SUPPORTED and CMAKE_LINK_GROUP_USING_<FEATURE> variables are not used.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_LINK_LIBRARY
var.desc: This variable defines the semantics of the specified link library <FEATURE> when linking with the link language <LANG>. It takes precedence over CMAKE_LINK_LIBRARY_<FEATURE>_ATTRIBUTES if that variable is also defined for the same <FEATURE>, but otherwise has similar effects. See CMAKE_LINK_LIBRARY_<FEATURE>_ATTRIBUTES for further details.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_LINK_LIBRARY_FILE_FLAG
var.desc: Language-specific flag to be used to link a library specified by a path to its file.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_LINK_LIBRARY_FLAG
var.desc: Flag to be used to link a library into a shared library or executable.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_LINK_LIBRARY_SUFFIX
var.desc: Language-specific suffix for libraries that you link to.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_LINK_LIBRARY_USING
var.desc: Set to TRUE if the <FEATURE>, as defined by variable CMAKE_<LANG>_LINK_LIBRARY_USING_<FEATURE>, is supported for the linker language <LANG>.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_LINK_LIBRARY_USING
var.desc: This variable defines how to link a library or framework for the specified <FEATURE> when a LINK_LIBRARY generator expression is used and the link language for the target is <LANG>. For this variable to have any effect, the associated CMAKE_<LANG>_LINK_LIBRARY_USING_<FEATURE>_SUPPORTED variable must be set to true.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_LINK_MODE
var.desc: Defines how the link step is done. The possible values are:

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_LINK_WHAT_YOU_USE_FLAG
var.desc: Linker flag used by LINK_WHAT_YOU_USE to tell the linker to link all shared libraries specified on the command line even if none of their symbols is needed. This is an implementation detail used so that the command in CMAKE_LINK_WHAT_YOU_USE_CHECK can check the binary for unnecessarily-linked shared libraries.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_OUTPUT_EXTENSION
var.desc: Extension for the output of a compile for a single file.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_PLATFORM_ID
var.desc: An internal variable subject to change.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_SIMULATE_ID
var.desc: Identification string of the "simulated" compiler.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_SIMULATE_VERSION
var.desc: Version string of "simulated" compiler.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_SIZEOF_DATA_PTR
var.desc: Size of pointer-to-data types for language <LANG>.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_SOURCE_FILE_EXTENSIONS
var.desc: Extensions of source files for the given language.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_STANDARD
var.desc: The variations are:

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_STANDARD_DEFAULT
var.desc: The compiler's default standard for the language <LANG>. Empty if the compiler has no conception of standard levels.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_STANDARD_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES
var.desc: Include directories to be used for every source file compiled with the <LANG> compiler. This is meant for specification of system include directories needed by the language for the current platform. The directories always appear at the end of the include path passed to the compiler.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_STANDARD_LATEST
var.desc: This variable represents the minimum between the latest version of the standard for language <LANG> which is supported by the current compiler and the latest version which is supported by CMake. Its value will be set to one of the supported values of the corresponding <LANG>_STANDARD target property; see the documentation of that property for a list of supported languages.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_STANDARD_LIBRARIES
var.desc: Libraries linked into every executable and shared library linked for language <LANG>. This is meant for specification of system libraries needed by the language for the current platform.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_STANDARD_LINK_DIRECTORIES
var.desc: Link directories specified for every executable and library linked for language <LANG>. This is meant for specification of system link directories needed by the language for the current platform.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_STANDARD_REQUIRED
var.desc: The variations are:

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_USING_LINKER
var.desc: This variable defines how to specify the <TYPE> linker for the link step, as controlled by the CMAKE_LINKER_TYPE variable or the LINKER_TYPE target property. Depending on the value of the CMAKE_<LANG>_LINK_MODE variable, CMAKE_<LANG>_USING_LINKER_<TYPE> can hold compiler flags for the link step, or the path to the linker tool.

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_USING_LINKER_MODE
var.desc: This variable controls how the value of the CMAKE_<LANG>_USING_LINKER_<TYPE> variable should be interpreted. The supported linker mode values are:

var.name: CMAKE_CSharp_VISIBILITY_PRESET
var.desc: Default value for the <LANG>_VISIBILITY_PRESET target property when a target is created.

var.name: CMAKE_CTEST_ARGUMENTS

For example, the contents of a xxxFLAGS environment variable will be prepended, where xxx will be language-specific but not necessarily the same as <LANG> (e.g. CXXFLAGS for CXX, FFLAGS for Fortran, and so on). This value is a command-line string fragment. Therefore, multiple options should be separated by spaces, and options with spaces should be quoted.

For example, the contents of a xxxFLAGS environment variable will be prepended, where xxx will be language-specific but not necessarily the same as <LANG> (e.g. CXXFLAGS for CXX, FFLAGS for Fortran, and so on). This value is a command-line string fragment. Therefore, multiple options should be separated by spaces, and options with spaces should be quoted.

var.desc: This variable controls how the value of the CMAKE_<LANG>_USING_LINKER_<TYPE> variable should be interpreted. The supported linker mode values are:

var.name: CMAKE_C_VISIBILITY_PRESET
var.desc: Default value for the <LANG>_VISIBILITY_PRESET target property when a target is created.

var.name: CMAKE_DEBUGGER_WORKING_DIRECTORY
var.desc: This variable is used to initialize the DEBUGGER_WORKING_DIRECTORY property on each target as it is created. See that target property for additional information.

var.name: CMAKE_DEBUG_POSTFIX
var.desc: See variable CMAKE_<CONFIG>_POSTFIX.

var.name: CMAKE_DEBUG_TARGET_PROPERTIES
var.desc: Enables tracing output for target properties.

var.name: CMAKE_DEFAULT_BUILD_TYPE
var.desc: Specifies the configuration to use by default in a build.ninja file in the Ninja Multi-Config generator. If this variable is specified, build.ninja uses build rules from build-<Config>.ninja by default. All custom commands are executed with this configuration. If the variable is not specified, the first item from CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES is used instead.

var.name: CMAKE_DEFAULT_CONFIGS
var.desc: Specifies a semicolon-separated list of configurations to build for a target in build.ninja if no :<Config> suffix is specified in the Ninja Multi-Config generator. If it is set to all, all configurations from CMAKE_CROSS_CONFIGS are used. If it is not specified, it defaults to CMAKE_DEFAULT_BUILD_TYPE.

var.name: CMAKE_DEPENDS_IN_PROJECT_ONLY
var.desc: When set to TRUE in a directory, the build system produced by the Makefile Generators is set up to only consider dependencies on source files that appear either in the source or in the binary directories. Changes to source files outside of these directories will not cause rebuilds.

var.name: CMAKE_DEPENDS_USE_COMPILER
var.desc: For the Makefile Generators, source dependencies are now, for a selection of compilers, generated by the compiler itself. By defining this variable with value FALSE, you can restore the legacy behavior (i.e. using CMake for dependencies discovery).

var.name: CMAKE_DIRECTORY_LABELS
var.desc: Specify labels for the current directory.

var.name: CMAKE_DISABLE_FIND_PACKAGE_<PackageName>
var.desc: Variable for disabling find_package() calls.

var.name: CMAKE_DISABLE_PRECOMPILE_HEADERS
var.desc: Default value for DISABLE_PRECOMPILE_HEADERS of targets.

var.name: CMAKE_DLL_NAME_WITH_SOVERSION
var.desc: This variable is used to initialize the DLL_NAME_WITH_SOVERSION property on shared library targets for the Windows platform, which is selected when the WIN32 variable is set.

var.name: CMAKE_DL_LIBS
var.desc: This variable contains a name of the dynamic loading library, or a list of system libraries needed to use the dlopen() and dlclose() functions.

var.name: CMAKE_DOTNET_SDK
var.desc: Default value for DOTNET_SDK property of targets.

var.name: CMAKE_DOTNET_TARGET_FRAMEWORK
var.desc: Default value for DOTNET_TARGET_FRAMEWORK property of targets.

var.name: CMAKE_DOTNET_TARGET_FRAMEWORK_VERSION
var.desc: Default value for DOTNET_TARGET_FRAMEWORK_VERSION property of targets.

var.name: CMAKE_ECLIPSE_GENERATE_LINKED_RESOURCES
var.desc: This cache variable is used by the Eclipse project generator. See cmake-generators(7).

var.name: CMAKE_ECLIPSE_GENERATE_SOURCE_PROJECT
var.desc: This cache variable is used by the Eclipse project generator. See cmake-generators(7).

var.name: CMAKE_ECLIPSE_MAKE_ARGUMENTS
var.desc: This cache variable is used by the Eclipse project generator. See cmake-generators(7).

var.name: CMAKE_ECLIPSE_RESOURCE_ENCODING
var.desc: This cache variable tells the Eclipse CDT4 project generator to set the resource encoding to the given value in generated project files. If no value is given, no encoding will be set.

var.name: CMAKE_ECLIPSE_VERSION
var.desc: This cache variable is used by the Eclipse project generator. See cmake-generators(7).

var.name: CMAKE_EDIT_COMMAND
var.desc: Full path to cmake-gui(1) or ccmake(1). Defined only for Makefile Generators and Ninja Generators when not using any Extra Generators.

var.name: CMAKE_ENABLE_EXPORTS
var.desc: Specify whether executables export symbols for loadable modules.

var.name: CMAKE_ERROR_DEPRECATED
var.desc: Whether to issue errors for deprecated functionality.

var.name: CMAKE_ERROR_ON_ABSOLUTE_INSTALL_DESTINATION
var.desc: Ask cmake_install.cmake script to error out as soon as a file with absolute INSTALL DESTINATION is encountered.

var.name: CMAKE_EXECUTABLE_ENABLE_EXPORTS
var.desc: Specify whether executables export symbols for loadable modules.

var.name: CMAKE_EXECUTABLE_SUFFIX
var.desc: The suffix for executables on the target platform.

var.name: CMAKE_EXECUTABLE_SUFFIX_<LANG>
var.desc: The suffix to use for the end of an executable filename of <LANG> compiler target architecture, if any.

var.name: CMAKE_EXECUTE_PROCESS_COMMAND_ECHO
var.desc: If this variable is set to STDERR, STDOUT or NONE then commands in execute_process() calls will be printed to either stderr or stdout or not at all.

var.name: CMAKE_EXECUTE_PROCESS_COMMAND_ERROR_IS_FATAL
var.desc: Specify a default for the execute_process() command's COMMAND_ERROR_IS_FATAL option. This variable is ignored when a RESULTS_VARIABLE or RESULT_VARIABLE keyword is supplied to the command.

var.name: CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS
var.desc: Linker flags to be used to create executables.

var.name: CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS_<CONFIG>
var.desc: Flags to be used when linking an executable.

var.name: CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS_<CONFIG>_INIT
var.desc: Value used to initialize the CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS_<CONFIG> cache entry the first time a build tree is configured. This variable is meant to be set by a toolchain file. CMake may prepend or append content to the value based on the environment and target platform.

var.name: CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS_INIT
var.desc: Value used to initialize the CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS cache entry the first time a build tree is configured. This variable is meant to be set by a toolchain file. CMake may prepend or append content to the value based on the environment and target platform.

var.name: CMAKE_EXPORT_BUILD_DATABASE
var.desc: Enable/Disable output of module compile commands during the build.

var.name: CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS
var.desc: Enable/Disable output of compile commands during generation.

var.name: CMAKE_EXPORT_FIND_PACKAGE_NAME
var.desc: Initializes the value of EXPORT_FIND_PACKAGE_NAME.

var.name: CMAKE_EXPORT_NO_PACKAGE_REGISTRY
var.desc: Disable the export(PACKAGE) command when CMP0090 is not set to NEW.

var.name: CMAKE_EXPORT_PACKAGE_REGISTRY
var.desc: Enables the export(PACKAGE) command when CMP0090 is set to NEW.

var.name: CMAKE_EXPORT_SARIF
var.desc: Enable or disable CMake diagnostics output in SARIF format for a project.

var.name: CMAKE_EXTRA_GENERATOR
var.desc: The extra generator used to build the project. See cmake-generators(7).

var.name: CMAKE_EXTRA_SHARED_LIBRARY_SUFFIXES
var.desc: Additional suffixes for shared libraries.

var.name: CMAKE_FASTBUILD_ALLOW_RESPONSE_FILE
var.desc: Enables FASTBuild's AllowResponseFile option.

var.name: CMAKE_FASTBUILD_CACHE_PATH
var.desc: Specifies the directory for the FASTBuild artifact cache in the generated file.

var.name: CMAKE_FASTBUILD_CAPTURE_SYSTEM_ENV
var.desc: Controls capturing of the system environment into fbuild.bff. Setting it to OFF makes the invocation of all tools (compilers and other external processes) hermetic.

var.name: CMAKE_FASTBUILD_CLANG_GCC_UPDATE_XLANG_ARG
var.desc: Enables FASTBuild's ClangGCCUpdateXLanguageArg option.

var.name: CMAKE_FASTBUILD_CLANG_REWRITE_INCLUDES
var.desc: Enables FASTBuild's ClangRewriteIncludes option.

var.name: CMAKE_FASTBUILD_COMPILER_EXTRA_FILES
var.desc: Specifies a semicolon-separated list of additional files (usually DLLs) to include in the FASTBuild Compiler() node.

var.name: CMAKE_FASTBUILD_ENV_OVERRIDES
var.desc: Allows overriding environment variables in the captured environment written to fbuild.bff.

var.name: CMAKE_FASTBUILD_FORCE_RESPONSE_FILE
var.desc: Enables FASTBuild's ForceResponseFile option.

var.name: CMAKE_FASTBUILD_IDE_ARGS
var.desc: Specifies the command-line arguments used when invoking fbuild from IDE projects.

var.name: CMAKE_FASTBUILD_SOURCE_MAPPING
var.desc: Sets FASTBuild's SourceMapping_Experimental option.

var.name: CMAKE_FASTBUILD_TRACK_BYPRODUCTS_AS_OUTPUT
var.desc: By default, custom commands declaring only BYPRODUCTS will always run unconditionally. You can use this variable to make FASTBuild rerun the command only when its inputs have changed or the byproduct file is missing.

var.name: CMAKE_FASTBUILD_USE_DETERMINISTIC_PATHS
var.desc: Enables FASTBuild's UseDeterministicPaths_Experimental option.

var.name: CMAKE_FASTBUILD_USE_LIGHTCACHE
var.desc: Enables FASTBuild’s light caching mode, which accelerates cache lookups by parsing source files directly (instead of invoking the compiler preprocessor).

var.name: CMAKE_FASTBUILD_USE_RELATIVE_PATHS
var.desc: Enables FASTBuild's UseRelativePaths_Experimental option.

var.name: CMAKE_FASTBUILD_VERBOSE_GENERATOR
var.desc: Enables verbose logging during FASTBuild file generation.

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_APPBUNDLE
var.desc: This variable affects how find_* commands choose between macOS Application Bundles and unix-style package components.

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_DEBUG_MODE
var.desc: Print extra find call information for the following commands to standard error:

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_DEBUG_MODE_NO_IMPLICIT_CONFIGURE_LOG
var.desc: The following commands will report configure log events when they experience a transition between found and not-found states or when the result is first defined:

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_FRAMEWORK
var.desc: This variable affects how find_* commands choose between macOS Frameworks and unix-style package components.

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_LIBRARY_CUSTOM_LIB_SUFFIX
var.desc: Specify a <suffix> to tell the find_library() command to search in a lib<suffix> directory before each lib directory that would normally be searched.

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_LIBRARY_PREFIXES
var.desc: Prefixes to prepend when looking for libraries.

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_LIBRARY_SUFFIXES
var.desc: Suffixes to append when looking for libraries.

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_NO_INSTALL_PREFIX
var.desc: Exclude the values of the CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX and CMAKE_STAGING_PREFIX variables from CMAKE_SYSTEM_PREFIX_PATH. CMake adds these project-destination prefixes to CMAKE_SYSTEM_PREFIX_PATH by default in order to support building a series of dependent packages and installing them into a common prefix. Set CMAKE_FIND_NO_INSTALL_PREFIX to TRUE to suppress this behavior.

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_PACKAGE_NAME
var.desc: Defined by the find_package() command while loading a find module to record the caller-specified package name. See command documentation for details.

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_PACKAGE_NO_PACKAGE_REGISTRY
var.desc: By default this variable is not set. If neither CMAKE_FIND_USE_PACKAGE_REGISTRY nor CMAKE_FIND_PACKAGE_NO_PACKAGE_REGISTRY is set, then find_package() will use the User Package Registry unless the NO_CMAKE_PACKAGE_REGISTRY option is provided.

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_PACKAGE_NO_SYSTEM_PACKAGE_REGISTRY
var.desc: By default this variable is not set. If neither CMAKE_FIND_USE_SYSTEM_PACKAGE_REGISTRY nor CMAKE_FIND_PACKAGE_NO_SYSTEM_PACKAGE_REGISTRY is set, then find_package() will use the System Package Registry unless the NO_CMAKE_SYSTEM_PACKAGE_REGISTRY option is provided.

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_PACKAGE_PREFER_CONFIG
var.desc: Tell find_package() to try "Config" mode before "Module" mode if no mode was specified.

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_PACKAGE_REDIRECTS_DIR
var.desc: This read-only variable specifies a directory that the find_package() command will check first before searching anywhere else for a module or config package file. A config package file in this directory will always be found in preference to any other Find module file or config package file.

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_PACKAGE_RESOLVE_SYMLINKS
var.desc: Set to TRUE to tell find_package() calls to resolve symbolic links in the value of <PackageName>_DIR.

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_PACKAGE_SORT_DIRECTION
var.desc: The sorting direction used by CMAKE_FIND_PACKAGE_SORT_ORDER. It can assume one of the following values:

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_PACKAGE_SORT_ORDER
var.desc: The default order for sorting directories which match a search path containing a glob expression found using find_package(). It can assume one of the following values:

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_PACKAGE_TARGETS_GLOBAL
var.desc: Setting to TRUE promotes all IMPORTED targets discovered by find_package() to a GLOBAL scope.

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_PACKAGE_WARN_NO_MODULE
var.desc: Tell find_package() to warn if called without an explicit mode.

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_REQUIRED
var.desc: If enabled, the following commands are treated as having the REQUIRED keyword unless provided with the OPTIONAL keyword:

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH
var.desc: Semicolon-separated list of root paths to search on the filesystem.

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_INCLUDE
var.desc: This variable controls whether the CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH and CMAKE_SYSROOT are used by find_file() and find_path().

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_LIBRARY
var.desc: This variable controls whether the CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH and CMAKE_SYSROOT are used by find_library().

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_PACKAGE
var.desc: This variable controls whether the CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH and CMAKE_SYSROOT are used by find_package().

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH_MODE_PROGRAM
var.desc: This variable controls whether the CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH and CMAKE_SYSROOT are used by find_program().

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_USE_CMAKE_ENVIRONMENT_PATH
var.desc: Controls the default behavior of the following commands for whether or not to search paths provided by cmake-specific environment variables:

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_USE_CMAKE_PATH
var.desc: Controls the default behavior of the following commands for whether or not to search paths provided by cmake-specific cache variables:

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_USE_CMAKE_SYSTEM_PATH
var.desc: Controls the default behavior of the following commands for whether or not to search paths provided by platform-specific cmake variables:

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_USE_INSTALL_PREFIX
var.desc: Controls the default behavior of the following commands for whether or not to search the locations in the CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX and CMAKE_STAGING_PREFIX variables.

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_USE_PACKAGE_REGISTRY
var.desc: Controls the default behavior of the find_package() command for whether or not to search paths provided by the User Package Registry.

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_USE_PACKAGE_ROOT_PATH
var.desc: Controls the default behavior of the following commands for whether or not to search paths provided by <PackageName>_ROOT variables:

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_USE_SYSTEM_ENVIRONMENT_PATH
var.desc: Controls the default behavior of the following commands for whether or not to search paths provided by standard system environment variables:

var.name: CMAKE_FIND_USE_SYSTEM_PACKAGE_REGISTRY
var.desc: Controls searching the System Package Registry by the find_package() command.

var.name: CMAKE_FOLDER
var.desc: Set the folder name. Use to organize targets in an IDE.

var.name: CMAKE_FRAMEWORK
var.desc: Default value for FRAMEWORK of targets.

var.name: CMAKE_FRAMEWORK_MULTI_CONFIG_POSTFIX_<CONFIG>
var.desc: Default framework filename postfix under configuration <CONFIG> when using a multi-config generator.

var.name: CMAKE_FRAMEWORK_PATH
var.desc: Semicolon-separated list of directories specifying a search path for macOS frameworks used by the find_library(), find_package(), find_path(), and find_file() commands.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_ANDROID_TOOLCHAIN_MACHINE
var.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android this variable contains the toolchain binutils machine name (e.g. gcc -dumpmachine). The binutils typically have a <machine>- prefix on their name.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_ANDROID_TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX
var.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android this variable contains the absolute path prefixing the toolchain GNU compiler and its binutils.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_ANDROID_TOOLCHAIN_SUFFIX
var.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android this variable contains the host platform suffix of the toolchain GNU compiler and its binutils.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_ARCHIVER_WRAPPER_FLAG
var.desc: Defines the syntax of compiler driver option to pass options to the archiver tool. It will be used to translate the ARCHIVER: prefix in the static library options (see STATIC_LIBRARY_OPTIONS).

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_ARCHIVER_WRAPPER_FLAG_SEP
var.desc: This variable is used with CMAKE_<LANG>_ARCHIVER_WRAPPER_FLAG variable to format ARCHIVER: prefix in the static library options (see STATIC_LIBRARY_OPTIONS).

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_ARCHIVE_APPEND
var.desc: Rule variable to append to a static archive.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_ARCHIVE_CREATE
var.desc: Rule variable to create a new static archive.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_ARCHIVE_FINISH
var.desc: Rule variable to finish an existing static archive.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_BYTE_ORDER
var.desc: Byte order of <LANG> compiler target architecture, if known. If defined and not empty, the value is one of:

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_CLANG_TIDY
var.desc: Default value for <LANG>_CLANG_TIDY target property when <LANG> is C, CXX, OBJC or OBJCXX.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_CLANG_TIDY_EXPORT_FIXES_DIR
var.desc: Default value for <LANG>_CLANG_TIDY_EXPORT_FIXES_DIR target property when <LANG> is C, CXX, OBJC or OBJCXX.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER
var.desc: The full path to the compiler for LANG.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER_ABI
var.desc: An internal variable subject to change.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER_AR
var.desc: A wrapper around ar adding the appropriate --plugin option for the compiler.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER_ARCHITECTURE_ID
var.desc: List of identifiers indicating the target architecture(s) of the compiler for language <LANG>.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER_EXTERNAL_TOOLCHAIN
var.desc: The external toolchain for cross-compiling, if supported.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT
var.desc: Identification string of the compiler frontend variant.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER_ID
var.desc: Compiler identification string.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER_LAUNCHER
var.desc: Default value for <LANG>_COMPILER_LAUNCHER target property. This variable is used to initialize the property on each target as it is created. This is done only when <LANG> is C, CXX, Fortran, HIP, ISPC, OBJC, OBJCXX, or CUDA.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER_LINKER
var.desc: The full path to the linker for LANG.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER_LINKER_FRONTEND_VARIANT
var.desc: Identification string of the linker frontend variant.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER_LINKER_ID
var.desc: Linker identification string.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER_LINKER_VERSION
var.desc: Linker version string.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER_LOADED
var.desc: Defined to true if the language is enabled.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER_PREDEFINES_COMMAND
var.desc: Command that outputs the compiler pre definitions.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER_RANLIB
var.desc: A wrapper around ranlib adding the appropriate --plugin option for the compiler.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER_TARGET
var.desc: The target for cross-compiling, if supported.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER_VERSION
var.desc: Compiler version string.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER_VERSION_INTERNAL
var.desc: An internal variable subject to change.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_COMPILE_OBJECT
var.desc: Rule variable to compile a single object file.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_CPPCHECK
var.desc: Default value for <LANG>_CPPCHECK target property. This variable is used to initialize the property on each target as it is created. This is done only when <LANG> is C or CXX.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_CPPLINT
var.desc: Default value for <LANG>_CPPLINT target property. This variable is used to initialize the property on each target as it is created. This is done only when <LANG> is C or CXX.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_CREATE_SHARED_LIBRARY
var.desc: Rule variable to create a shared library.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_CREATE_SHARED_LIBRARY_ARCHIVE
var.desc: Rule variable to create a shared library with archive.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_CREATE_SHARED_MODULE
var.desc: Rule variable to create a shared module.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_CREATE_STATIC_LIBRARY
var.desc: Rule variable to create a static library.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_DEVICE_LINK_MODE
var.desc: Defines how the device link step is done. The possible values are:

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_EXTENSIONS
var.desc: The variations are:

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_EXTENSIONS_DEFAULT
var.desc: Compiler's default extensions mode. Used as the default for the <LANG>_EXTENSIONS target property when CMAKE_<LANG>_EXTENSIONS is not set (see CMP0128).

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_FLAGS
var.desc: Language-wide flags for language <LANG> used when building for all configurations. These flags will be passed to all invocations of the compiler. This includes invocations that drive compiling and those that drive linking.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_FLAGS
var.desc: Language-wide flags for language <LANG> used when building for the <CONFIG> configuration. These flags will be passed to all invocations of the compiler in the corresponding configuration. This includes invocations that drive compiling and those that drive linking.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_FLAGS
var.desc: Value used to initialize the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG> cache entry the first time a build tree is configured for language <LANG>. This variable is meant to be set by a toolchain file. CMake may prepend or append content to the value based on the environment and target platform.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_FLAGS_DEBUG
var.desc: This variable is the Debug variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG> variable.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_FLAGS_DEBUG_INIT
var.desc: This variable is the Debug variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG>_INIT variable.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_FLAGS_INIT
var.desc: Value used to initialize the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS cache entry the first time a build tree is configured for language <LANG>. This variable is meant to be set by a toolchain file. CMake may prepend or append content to the value based on the environment and target platform. For example, the contents of a xxxFLAGS environment variable will be prepended, where xxx will be language-specific but not necessarily the same as <LANG> (e.g. CXXFLAGS for CXX, FFLAGS for Fortran, and so on). This value is a command-line string fragment. Therefore, multiple options should be separated by spaces, and options with spaces should be quoted.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_FLAGS_MINSIZEREL
var.desc: This variable is the MinSizeRel variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG> variable.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_FLAGS_MINSIZEREL_INIT
var.desc: This variable is the MinSizeRel variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG>_INIT variable.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_FLAGS_RELEASE
var.desc: This variable is the Release variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG> variable.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_FLAGS_RELEASE_INIT
var.desc: This variable is the Release variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG>_INIT variable.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_FLAGS_RELWITHDEBINFO
var.desc: This variable is the RelWithDebInfo variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG> variable.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_FLAGS_RELWITHDEBINFO_INIT
var.desc: This variable is the RelWithDebInfo variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG>_INIT variable.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_FORMAT
var.desc: Set to FIXED or FREE to indicate the Fortran source layout.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_HOST_COMPILER
var.desc: This variable is available when <LANG> is CUDA or HIP.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_HOST_COMPILER_ID
var.desc: This variable is available when <LANG> is CUDA or HIP and CMAKE_<LANG>_COMPILER_ID is NVIDIA. It contains the identity of the host compiler invoked by nvcc, either by default or as specified by CMAKE_<LANG>_HOST_COMPILER, among possibilities documented by CMAKE_<LANG>_COMPILER_ID.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_HOST_COMPILER_VERSION
var.desc: This variable is available when <LANG> is CUDA or HIP and CMAKE_<LANG>_COMPILER_ID is NVIDIA. It contains the version of the host compiler invoked by nvcc, either by default or as specified by CMAKE_<LANG>_HOST_COMPILER, in the same format as CMAKE_<LANG>_COMPILER_VERSION.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_ICSTAT
var.desc: Default value for <LANG>_ICSTAT target property. This variable is used to initialize the property on each target as it is created. This is done only when <LANG> is C or CXX.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_IGNORE_EXTENSIONS
var.desc: File extensions that should be ignored by the build.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_IMPLICIT_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES
var.desc: Directories implicitly searched by the compiler for header files.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_IMPLICIT_LINK_DIRECTORIES
var.desc: Implicit linker search path detected for language <LANG>.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_IMPLICIT_LINK_FRAMEWORK_DIRECTORIES
var.desc: Implicit linker framework search path detected for language <LANG>.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_IMPLICIT_LINK_LIBRARIES
var.desc: Implicit link libraries and flags detected for language <LANG>.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_INCLUDE_WHAT_YOU_USE
var.desc: Default value for <LANG>_INCLUDE_WHAT_YOU_USE target property. This variable is used to initialize the property on each target as it is created. This is done only when <LANG> is C or CXX.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_LIBRARY_ARCHITECTURE
var.desc: Target architecture library directory name detected for <LANG>.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_LINKER_LAUNCHER
var.desc: Default value for <LANG>_LINKER_LAUNCHER target property. This variable is used to initialize the property on each target as it is created. This is done only when <LANG> is one of:

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_LINKER_PREFERENCE
var.desc: An internal variable subject to change.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_LINKER_PREFERENCE_PROPAGATES
var.desc: An internal variable subject to change.

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_LINKER_WRAPPER_FLAG
var.desc: Defines the syntax of compiler driver option to pass options to the linker tool. It will be used to translate the LINKER: prefix in the link options (see add_link_options() and target_link_options()).

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_LINKER_WRAPPER_FLAG_SEP
var.desc: This variable is used with CMAKE_<LANG>_LINKER_WRAPPER_FLAG variable to format LINKER: prefix in the link options (see add_link_options() and target_link_options()).

var.name: CMAKE_Fortran_LINK_DEF_FILE_FLAG

This value is a command-line string fragment. Therefore, multiple options should be separated by spaces, and options with spaces should be quoted.

var.name: CMAKE_ISPC_FLAGS
var.desc: Language-wide flags for language <LANG> used when building for all configurations. These flags will be passed to all invocations of the compiler. This includes invocations that drive compiling and those that drive linking.

var.name: CMAKE_ISPC_FLAGS
var.desc: Language-wide flags for language <LANG> used when building for the <CONFIG> configuration. These flags will be passed to all invocations of the compiler in the corresponding configuration. This includes invocations that drive compiling and those that drive linking.

var.name: CMAKE_ISPC_FLAGS
var.desc: Value used to initialize the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG> cache entry the first time a build tree is configured for language <LANG>. This variable is meant to be set by a toolchain file. CMake may prepend or append content to the value based on the environment and target platform.

var.name: CMAKE_ISPC_FLAGS_DEBUG
var.desc: This variable is the Debug variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG> variable.

var.name: CMAKE_ISPC_FLAGS_DEBUG_INIT
var.desc: This variable is the Debug variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG>_INIT variable.

var.name: CMAKE_ISPC_FLAGS_INIT
var.desc: Value used to initialize the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS cache entry the first time a build tree is configured for language <LANG>. This variable is meant to be set by a toolchain file. CMake may prepend or append content to the value based on the environment and target platform. For example, the contents of a xxxFLAGS environment variable will be prepended, where xxx will be language-specific but not necessarily the same as <LANG> (e.g. CXXFLAGS for CXX, FFLAGS for Fortran, and so on). This value is a command-line string fragment. Therefore, multiple options should be separated by spaces, and options with spaces should be quoted.

var.name: CMAKE_ISPC_FLAGS_MINSIZEREL
var.desc: This variable is the MinSizeRel variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG> variable.

var.name: CMAKE_ISPC_FLAGS_MINSIZEREL_INIT
var.desc: This variable is the MinSizeRel variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG>_INIT variable.

var.name: CMAKE_ISPC_FLAGS_RELEASE

var.desc: This variable is available when <LANG> is CUDA or HIP and CMAKE_<LANG>_COMPILER_ID is NVIDIA. It contains the version of the host compiler invoked by nvcc, either by default or as specified by CMAKE_<LANG>_HOST_COMPILER, in the same format as CMAKE_<LANG>_COMPILER_VERSION.

var.name: CMAKE_ISPC_LINK_GROUP_USING
var.desc: This variable defines how to link a group of libraries for the specified <FEATURE> when a LINK_GROUP generator expression is used and the link language for the target is <LANG>. For this variable to have any effect, the associated CMAKE_<LANG>_LINK_GROUP_USING_<FEATURE>_SUPPORTED variable must be set to true.

var.name: CMAKE_ISPC_LINK_GROUP_USING
var.desc: This variable specifies whether the <FEATURE> is supported for the link language <LANG>. If this variable is true, then the <FEATURE> must be defined by CMAKE_<LANG>_LINK_GROUP_USING_<FEATURE>, and the more generic CMAKE_LINK_GROUP_USING_<FEATURE>_SUPPORTED and CMAKE_LINK_GROUP_USING_<FEATURE> variables are not used.

var.name: CMAKE_ISPC_LINK_LIBRARY
var.desc: This variable defines the semantics of the specified link library <FEATURE> when linking with the link language <LANG>. It takes precedence over CMAKE_LINK_LIBRARY_<FEATURE>_ATTRIBUTES if that variable is also defined for the same <FEATURE>, but otherwise has similar effects. See CMAKE_LINK_LIBRARY_<FEATURE>_ATTRIBUTES for further details.

var.name: CMAKE_ISPC_LINK_LIBRARY_USING
var.desc: This variable defines how to link a library or framework for the specified <FEATURE> when a LINK_LIBRARY generator expression is used and the link language for the target is <LANG>. For this variable to have any effect, the associated CMAKE_<LANG>_LINK_LIBRARY_USING_<FEATURE>_SUPPORTED variable must be set to true.

This is an implementation detail used so that the command in CMAKE_LINK_WHAT_YOU_USE_CHECK can check the binary for unnecessarily-linked shared libraries.

Its value will be set to one of the supported values of the corresponding <LANG>_STANDARD target property; see the documentation of that property for a list of supported languages.
