var.name: CMAKE_SKIP_INSTALL_RPATH
var.desc: Do not include RPATHs in the install tree.

var.name: CMAKE_SKIP_INSTALL_RULES
var.desc: Whether to disable generation of installation rules.

var.name: CMAKE_SKIP_LINTING
var.desc: Default value for the SKIP_LINTING target property.

var.name: CMAKE_SKIP_RPATH
var.desc: If true, do not add run time path information.

var.name: CMAKE_SKIP_TEST_ALL_DEPENDENCY
var.desc: Control whether the test target depends on the all target.

var.name: CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR
var.desc: The path to the top level of the source tree.

var.name: CMAKE_STAGING_PREFIX
var.desc: This variable may be set to a path to install to when cross-compiling. This can be useful if the path in CMAKE_SYSROOT is read-only, or otherwise should remain pristine.

var.name: CMAKE_STATIC_LIBRARY_PREFIX
var.desc: The prefix for static libraries that you link to.

var.name: CMAKE_STATIC_LIBRARY_SUFFIX
var.desc: The suffix for static libraries that you link to.

var.name: CMAKE_STATIC_LINKER_FLAGS
var.desc: Flags to be used to create static libraries. These flags will be passed to the archiver when creating a static library.

var.name: CMAKE_STATIC_LINKER_FLAGS_<CONFIG>
var.desc: Flags to be used to create static libraries. These flags will be passed to the archiver when creating a static library in the <CONFIG> configuration.

var.name: CMAKE_STATIC_LINKER_FLAGS_<CONFIG>_INIT
var.desc: Value used to initialize the CMAKE_STATIC_LINKER_FLAGS_<CONFIG> cache entry the first time a build tree is configured. This variable is meant to be set by a toolchain file. CMake may prepend or append content to the value based on the environment and target platform.

var.name: CMAKE_STATIC_LINKER_FLAGS_INIT
var.desc: Value used to initialize the CMAKE_STATIC_LINKER_FLAGS cache entry the first time a build tree is configured. This variable is meant to be set by a toolchain file. CMake may prepend or append content to the value based on the environment and target platform.

var.name: CMAKE_SUBLIME_TEXT_2_ENV_SETTINGS
var.desc: This variable contains a list of env vars as a list of tokens with the syntax var=value.

var.name: CMAKE_SUBLIME_TEXT_2_EXCLUDE_BUILD_TREE
var.desc: If this variable evaluates to ON at the end of the top-level CMakeLists.txt file, the Sublime Text 2 extra generator excludes the build tree from the .sublime-project if it is inside the source tree.

var.name: CMAKE_SUPPRESS_REGENERATION
var.desc: If CMAKE_SUPPRESS_REGENERATION is OFF, which is default, then CMake adds a special target on which all other targets depend that checks the build system and optionally re-runs CMake to regenerate the build system when the target specification source changes.

var.name: CMAKE_SYSROOT
var.desc: Path to pass to the compiler in the --sysroot flag.

var.name: CMAKE_SYSROOT_COMPILE
var.desc: Path to pass to the compiler in the --sysroot flag when compiling source files. This is the same as CMAKE_SYSROOT but is used only for compiling sources and not linking.

var.name: CMAKE_SYSROOT_LINK
var.desc: Path to pass to the compiler in the --sysroot flag when linking. This is the same as CMAKE_SYSROOT but is used only for linking and not compiling sources.

var.name: CMAKE_SYSTEM
var.desc: Composite name of operating system CMake is compiling for.

var.name: CMAKE_SYSTEM_APPBUNDLE_PATH
var.desc: Search path for macOS application bundles used by the find_program(), and find_package() commands. By default it contains the standard directories for the current system. It is not intended to be modified by the project, use CMAKE_APPBUNDLE_PATH for this.

var.name: CMAKE_SYSTEM_FRAMEWORK_PATH
var.desc: Search path for macOS frameworks used by the find_library(), find_package(), find_path(), and find_file() commands. By default it contains the standard directories for the current system. It is not intended to be modified by the project, use CMAKE_FRAMEWORK_PATH for this.

var.name: CMAKE_SYSTEM_IGNORE_PATH
var.desc: Semicolon-separated list of directories to be ignored by the various find...() commands.

var.name: CMAKE_SYSTEM_IGNORE_PREFIX_PATH
var.desc: Semicolon-separated list of search prefixes to be ignored by the find_program(), find_library(), find_file(), and find_path() commands. The prefixes are also ignored by the Config mode of the find_package() command (Module mode is unaffected). To ignore specific directories instead, see CMAKE_SYSTEM_IGNORE_PATH.

var.name: CMAKE_SYSTEM_INCLUDE_PATH
var.desc: Semicolon-separated list of directories specifying a search path for the find_file() and find_path() commands. By default this contains the standard directories for the current system. It is not intended to be modified by the project; use CMAKE_INCLUDE_PATH for this. See also CMAKE_SYSTEM_PREFIX_PATH.

var.name: CMAKE_SYSTEM_LIBRARY_PATH
var.desc: Semicolon-separated list of directories specifying a search path for the find_library() command. By default this contains the standard directories for the current system. It is not intended to be modified by the project; use CMAKE_LIBRARY_PATH for this. See also CMAKE_SYSTEM_PREFIX_PATH.

var.name: CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME
var.desc: The name of the operating system for which CMake is to build. See the CMAKE_SYSTEM_VERSION variable for the OS version.

var.name: CMAKE_SYSTEM_PREFIX_PATH
var.desc: Semicolon-separated list of directories specifying installation prefixes to be searched by the find_package(), find_program(), find_library(), find_file(), and find_path() commands. Each command will add appropriate subdirectories (like bin, lib, or include) as specified in its own documentation.

var.name: CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR
var.desc: When not cross-compiling, this variable has the same value as the CMAKE_HOST_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR variable. In many cases, this will correspond to the target architecture for the build, but this is not guaranteed. (E.g. on Windows, the host may be AMD64 even when using a MSVC cl compiler with a 32-bit target.)

var.name: CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROGRAM_PATH
var.desc: Semicolon-separated list of directories specifying a search path for the find_program() command. By default this contains the standard directories for the current system. It is not intended to be modified by the project; use CMAKE_PROGRAM_PATH for this. See also CMAKE_SYSTEM_PREFIX_PATH.

var.name: CMAKE_SYSTEM_VERSION
var.desc: The version of the operating system for which CMake is to build. See the CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME variable for the OS name.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_ANDROID_TOOLCHAIN_MACHINE
var.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android this variable contains the toolchain binutils machine name (e.g. gcc -dumpmachine). The binutils typically have a <machine>- prefix on their name.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_ANDROID_TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX
var.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android this variable contains the absolute path prefixing the toolchain GNU compiler and its binutils.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_ANDROID_TOOLCHAIN_SUFFIX
var.desc: When Cross Compiling for Android this variable contains the host platform suffix of the toolchain GNU compiler and its binutils.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_ARCHIVER_WRAPPER_FLAG
var.desc: Defines the syntax of compiler driver option to pass options to the archiver tool. It will be used to translate the ARCHIVER: prefix in the static library options (see STATIC_LIBRARY_OPTIONS).

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_ARCHIVER_WRAPPER_FLAG_SEP
var.desc: This variable is used with CMAKE_<LANG>_ARCHIVER_WRAPPER_FLAG variable to format ARCHIVER: prefix in the static library options (see STATIC_LIBRARY_OPTIONS).

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_ARCHIVE_APPEND
var.desc: Rule variable to append to a static archive.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_ARCHIVE_CREATE
var.desc: Rule variable to create a new static archive.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_ARCHIVE_FINISH
var.desc: Rule variable to finish an existing static archive.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_BYTE_ORDER
var.desc: Byte order of <LANG> compiler target architecture, if known. If defined and not empty, the value is one of:

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_CLANG_TIDY
var.desc: Default value for <LANG>_CLANG_TIDY target property when <LANG> is C, CXX, OBJC or OBJCXX.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_CLANG_TIDY_EXPORT_FIXES_DIR
var.desc: Default value for <LANG>_CLANG_TIDY_EXPORT_FIXES_DIR target property when <LANG> is C, CXX, OBJC or OBJCXX.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_COMPILATION_MODE
var.desc: Specify how Swift compiles a target. This variable is used to initialize the Swift_COMPILATION_MODE property on targets as they are created.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_COMPILER
var.desc: The full path to the compiler for LANG.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_COMPILER_ABI
var.desc: An internal variable subject to change.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_COMPILER_AR
var.desc: A wrapper around ar adding the appropriate --plugin option for the compiler.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_COMPILER_ARCHITECTURE_ID
var.desc: List of identifiers indicating the target architecture(s) of the compiler for language <LANG>.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_COMPILER_EXTERNAL_TOOLCHAIN
var.desc: The external toolchain for cross-compiling, if supported.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT
var.desc: Identification string of the compiler frontend variant.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_COMPILER_ID
var.desc: Compiler identification string.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_COMPILER_LAUNCHER
var.desc: Default value for <LANG>_COMPILER_LAUNCHER target property. This variable is used to initialize the property on each target as it is created. This is done only when <LANG> is C, CXX, Fortran, HIP, ISPC, OBJC, OBJCXX, or CUDA.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_COMPILER_LINKER
var.desc: The full path to the linker for LANG.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_COMPILER_LINKER_FRONTEND_VARIANT
var.desc: Identification string of the linker frontend variant.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_COMPILER_LINKER_ID
var.desc: Linker identification string.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_COMPILER_LINKER_VERSION
var.desc: Linker version string.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_COMPILER_LOADED
var.desc: Defined to true if the language is enabled.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_COMPILER_PREDEFINES_COMMAND
var.desc: Command that outputs the compiler pre definitions.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_COMPILER_RANLIB
var.desc: A wrapper around ranlib adding the appropriate --plugin option for the compiler.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_COMPILER_TARGET
var.desc: The target for cross-compiling, if supported.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_COMPILER_VERSION
var.desc: Compiler version string.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_COMPILER_VERSION_INTERNAL
var.desc: An internal variable subject to change.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_COMPILE_OBJECT
var.desc: Rule variable to compile a single object file.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_CPPCHECK
var.desc: Default value for <LANG>_CPPCHECK target property. This variable is used to initialize the property on each target as it is created. This is done only when <LANG> is C or CXX.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_CPPLINT
var.desc: Default value for <LANG>_CPPLINT target property. This variable is used to initialize the property on each target as it is created. This is done only when <LANG> is C or CXX.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_CREATE_SHARED_LIBRARY
var.desc: Rule variable to create a shared library.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_CREATE_SHARED_LIBRARY_ARCHIVE
var.desc: Rule variable to create a shared library with archive.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_CREATE_SHARED_MODULE
var.desc: Rule variable to create a shared module.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_CREATE_STATIC_LIBRARY
var.desc: Rule variable to create a static library.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_DEVICE_LINK_MODE
var.desc: Defines how the device link step is done. The possible values are:

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_EXTENSIONS
var.desc: The variations are:

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_EXTENSIONS_DEFAULT
var.desc: Compiler's default extensions mode. Used as the default for the <LANG>_EXTENSIONS target property when CMAKE_<LANG>_EXTENSIONS is not set (see CMP0128).

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_FLAGS
var.desc: Language-wide flags for language <LANG> used when building for all configurations. These flags will be passed to all invocations of the compiler. This includes invocations that drive compiling and those that drive linking.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_FLAGS
var.desc: Language-wide flags for language <LANG> used when building for the <CONFIG> configuration. These flags will be passed to all invocations of the compiler in the corresponding configuration. This includes invocations that drive compiling and those that drive linking.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_FLAGS
var.desc: Value used to initialize the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG> cache entry the first time a build tree is configured for language <LANG>. This variable is meant to be set by a toolchain file. CMake may prepend or append content to the value based on the environment and target platform.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_FLAGS_DEBUG
var.desc: This variable is the Debug variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG> variable.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_FLAGS_DEBUG_INIT
var.desc: This variable is the Debug variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG>_INIT variable.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_FLAGS_INIT
var.desc: Value used to initialize the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS cache entry the first time a build tree is configured for language <LANG>. This variable is meant to be set by a toolchain file. CMake may prepend or append content to the value based on the environment and target platform. For example, the contents of a xxxFLAGS environment variable will be prepended, where xxx will be language-specific but not necessarily the same as <LANG> (e.g. CXXFLAGS for CXX, FFLAGS for Fortran, and so on). This value is a command-line string fragment. Therefore, multiple options should be separated by spaces, and options with spaces should be quoted.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_FLAGS_MINSIZEREL
var.desc: This variable is the MinSizeRel variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG> variable.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_FLAGS_MINSIZEREL_INIT
var.desc: This variable is the MinSizeRel variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG>_INIT variable.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_FLAGS_RELEASE
var.desc: This variable is the Release variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG> variable.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_FLAGS_RELEASE_INIT
var.desc: This variable is the Release variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG>_INIT variable.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_FLAGS_RELWITHDEBINFO
var.desc: This variable is the RelWithDebInfo variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG> variable.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_FLAGS_RELWITHDEBINFO_INIT
var.desc: This variable is the RelWithDebInfo variant of the CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS_<CONFIG>_INIT variable.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_HOST_COMPILER
var.desc: This variable is available when <LANG> is CUDA or HIP.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_HOST_COMPILER_ID
var.desc: This variable is available when <LANG> is CUDA or HIP and CMAKE_<LANG>_COMPILER_ID is NVIDIA. It contains the identity of the host compiler invoked by nvcc, either by default or as specified by CMAKE_<LANG>_HOST_COMPILER, among possibilities documented by CMAKE_<LANG>_COMPILER_ID.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_HOST_COMPILER_VERSION
var.desc: This variable is available when <LANG> is CUDA or HIP and CMAKE_<LANG>_COMPILER_ID is NVIDIA. It contains the version of the host compiler invoked by nvcc, either by default or as specified by CMAKE_<LANG>_HOST_COMPILER, in the same format as CMAKE_<LANG>_COMPILER_VERSION.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_ICSTAT
var.desc: Default value for <LANG>_ICSTAT target property. This variable is used to initialize the property on each target as it is created. This is done only when <LANG> is C or CXX.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_IGNORE_EXTENSIONS
var.desc: File extensions that should be ignored by the build.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_IMPLICIT_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES
var.desc: Directories implicitly searched by the compiler for header files.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_IMPLICIT_LINK_DIRECTORIES
var.desc: Implicit linker search path detected for language <LANG>.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_IMPLICIT_LINK_FRAMEWORK_DIRECTORIES
var.desc: Implicit linker framework search path detected for language <LANG>.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_IMPLICIT_LINK_LIBRARIES
var.desc: Implicit link libraries and flags detected for language <LANG>.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_INCLUDE_WHAT_YOU_USE
var.desc: Default value for <LANG>_INCLUDE_WHAT_YOU_USE target property. This variable is used to initialize the property on each target as it is created. This is done only when <LANG> is C or CXX.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_LANGUAGE_VERSION
var.desc: Set to the Swift language version number. If not set, the oldest legacy version known to be available in the host Xcode version is assumed:

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_LIBRARY_ARCHITECTURE
var.desc: Target architecture library directory name detected for <LANG>.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_LINKER_LAUNCHER
var.desc: Default value for <LANG>_LINKER_LAUNCHER target property. This variable is used to initialize the property on each target as it is created. This is done only when <LANG> is one of:

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_LINKER_PREFERENCE
var.desc: An internal variable subject to change.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_LINKER_PREFERENCE_PROPAGATES
var.desc: An internal variable subject to change.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_LINKER_WRAPPER_FLAG
var.desc: Defines the syntax of compiler driver option to pass options to the linker tool. It will be used to translate the LINKER: prefix in the link options (see add_link_options() and target_link_options()).

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_LINKER_WRAPPER_FLAG_SEP
var.desc: This variable is used with CMAKE_<LANG>_LINKER_WRAPPER_FLAG variable to format LINKER: prefix in the link options (see add_link_options() and target_link_options()).

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_LINK_DEF_FILE_FLAG
var.desc: Linker flag to be used to specify a .def file for dll creation with the toolchain for language <LANG>.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_LINK_EXECUTABLE
var.desc: Rule variable to link an executable.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_LINK_GROUP_USING
var.desc: This variable defines how to link a group of libraries for the specified <FEATURE> when a LINK_GROUP generator expression is used and the link language for the target is <LANG>. For this variable to have any effect, the associated CMAKE_<LANG>_LINK_GROUP_USING_<FEATURE>_SUPPORTED variable must be set to true.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_LINK_GROUP_USING
var.desc: This variable specifies whether the <FEATURE> is supported for the link language <LANG>. If this variable is true, then the <FEATURE> must be defined by CMAKE_<LANG>_LINK_GROUP_USING_<FEATURE>, and the more generic CMAKE_LINK_GROUP_USING_<FEATURE>_SUPPORTED and CMAKE_LINK_GROUP_USING_<FEATURE> variables are not used.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_LINK_LIBRARY
var.desc: This variable defines the semantics of the specified link library <FEATURE> when linking with the link language <LANG>. It takes precedence over CMAKE_LINK_LIBRARY_<FEATURE>_ATTRIBUTES if that variable is also defined for the same <FEATURE>, but otherwise has similar effects. See CMAKE_LINK_LIBRARY_<FEATURE>_ATTRIBUTES for further details.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_LINK_LIBRARY_FILE_FLAG
var.desc: Language-specific flag to be used to link a library specified by a path to its file.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_LINK_LIBRARY_FLAG
var.desc: Flag to be used to link a library into a shared library or executable.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_LINK_LIBRARY_SUFFIX
var.desc: Language-specific suffix for libraries that you link to.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_LINK_LIBRARY_USING
var.desc: Set to TRUE if the <FEATURE>, as defined by variable CMAKE_<LANG>_LINK_LIBRARY_USING_<FEATURE>, is supported for the linker language <LANG>.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_LINK_LIBRARY_USING
var.desc: This variable defines how to link a library or framework for the specified <FEATURE> when a LINK_LIBRARY generator expression is used and the link language for the target is <LANG>. For this variable to have any effect, the associated CMAKE_<LANG>_LINK_LIBRARY_USING_<FEATURE>_SUPPORTED variable must be set to true.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_LINK_MODE
var.desc: Defines how the link step is done. The possible values are:

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_LINK_WHAT_YOU_USE_FLAG
var.desc: Linker flag used by LINK_WHAT_YOU_USE to tell the linker to link all shared libraries specified on the command line even if none of their symbols is needed. This is an implementation detail used so that the command in CMAKE_LINK_WHAT_YOU_USE_CHECK can check the binary for unnecessarily-linked shared libraries.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_MODULE_DIRECTORY
var.desc: Swift module output directory.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_NUM_THREADS
var.desc: Number of threads for parallel compilation for Swift targets.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_OUTPUT_EXTENSION
var.desc: Extension for the output of a compile for a single file.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_PLATFORM_ID
var.desc: An internal variable subject to change.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_SIMULATE_ID
var.desc: Identification string of the "simulated" compiler.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_SIMULATE_VERSION
var.desc: Version string of "simulated" compiler.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_SIZEOF_DATA_PTR
var.desc: Size of pointer-to-data types for language <LANG>.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_SOURCE_FILE_EXTENSIONS
var.desc: Extensions of source files for the given language.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_STANDARD
var.desc: The variations are:

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_STANDARD_DEFAULT
var.desc: The compiler's default standard for the language <LANG>. Empty if the compiler has no conception of standard levels.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_STANDARD_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES
var.desc: Include directories to be used for every source file compiled with the <LANG> compiler. This is meant for specification of system include directories needed by the language for the current platform. The directories always appear at the end of the include path passed to the compiler.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_STANDARD_LATEST
var.desc: This variable represents the minimum between the latest version of the standard for language <LANG> which is supported by the current compiler and the latest version which is supported by CMake. Its value will be set to one of the supported values of the corresponding <LANG>_STANDARD target property; see the documentation of that property for a list of supported languages.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_STANDARD_LIBRARIES
var.desc: Libraries linked into every executable and shared library linked for language <LANG>. This is meant for specification of system libraries needed by the language for the current platform.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_STANDARD_LINK_DIRECTORIES
var.desc: Link directories specified for every executable and library linked for language <LANG>. This is meant for specification of system link directories needed by the language for the current platform.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_STANDARD_REQUIRED
var.desc: The variations are:

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_USING_LINKER
var.desc: This variable defines how to specify the <TYPE> linker for the link step, as controlled by the CMAKE_LINKER_TYPE variable or the LINKER_TYPE target property. Depending on the value of the CMAKE_<LANG>_LINK_MODE variable, CMAKE_<LANG>_USING_LINKER_<TYPE> can hold compiler flags for the link step, or the path to the linker tool.

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_USING_LINKER_MODE
var.desc: This variable controls how the value of the CMAKE_<LANG>_USING_LINKER_<TYPE> variable should be interpreted. The supported linker mode values are:

var.name: CMAKE_Swift_VISIBILITY_PRESET
var.desc: Default value for the <LANG>_VISIBILITY_PRESET target property when a target is created.

var.name: CMAKE_TASKING_TOOLSET
var.desc: Select the Tasking toolset which provides the compiler

var.name: CMAKE_TEST_LAUNCHER
var.desc: This variable is used to initialize the TEST_LAUNCHER target property of executable targets as they are created. It is used to specify a launcher for running tests, added by the add_test() command, that run an executable target.

var.name: CMAKE_TLS_CAINFO
var.desc: Specify the default value for the file(DOWNLOAD) and file(UPLOAD) commands' TLS_CAINFO options. It is unset by default.

var.name: CMAKE_TLS_VERIFY
var.desc: Specify the default value for the file(DOWNLOAD) and file(UPLOAD) commands' TLS_VERIFY options. If this variable is not set, the commands check the CMAKE_TLS_VERIFY environment variable. If neither is set, the default is on.

var.name: CMAKE_TLS_VERSION
var.desc: Specify the default value for the file(DOWNLOAD) and file(UPLOAD) commands' TLS_VERSION option. If this variable is not set, the commands check the CMAKE_TLS_VERSION environment variable. If neither is set, the default is TLS 1.2.

var.name: CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE
var.desc: Path to toolchain file supplied to cmake(1).

var.name: CMAKE_TRY_COMPILE_CONFIGURATION
var.desc: Build configuration used for try_compile() and try_run() projects.

var.name: CMAKE_TRY_COMPILE_NO_PLATFORM_VARIABLES
var.desc: Set to a true value to tell the try_compile() command not to propagate any platform variables into the test project.

var.name: CMAKE_TRY_COMPILE_PLATFORM_VARIABLES
var.desc: List of variables that the try_compile() command source file signature must propagate into the test project in order to target the same platform as the host project.

var.name: CMAKE_TRY_COMPILE_TARGET_TYPE
var.desc: Type of target generated for try_compile() calls using the source file signature. Valid values are:

var.name: CMAKE_TWEAK_VERSION
var.desc: Defined to 0 for compatibility with code written for older CMake versions that may have defined higher values.

var.name: CMAKE_UNITY_BUILD
var.desc: This variable is used to initialize the UNITY_BUILD property of targets when they are created. Setting it to true enables batch compilation of multiple sources within each target. This feature is known as a Unity or Jumbo build.

var.name: CMAKE_UNITY_BUILD_BATCH_SIZE
var.desc: This variable is used to initialize the UNITY_BUILD_BATCH_SIZE property of targets when they are created. It specifies the default upper limit on the number of source files that may be combined in any one unity source file when unity builds are enabled for a target.

var.name: CMAKE_UNITY_BUILD_RELOCATABLE
var.desc: This variable is used to initialize the UNITY_BUILD_RELOCATABLE property of targets when they are created. Setting it to true causes sources generated for CMAKE_UNITY_BUILD to #include the original source files using relative paths where possible.

var.name: CMAKE_UNITY_BUILD_UNIQUE_ID
var.desc: This variable is used to initialize the UNITY_BUILD_UNIQUE_ID property of targets when they are created. It specifies the name of the unique identifier generated per file in a unity build.

var.name: CMAKE_USER_MAKE_RULES_OVERRIDE
var.desc: Specify a CMake file that overrides platform information.

var.name: CMAKE_USER_MAKE_RULES_OVERRIDE_<LANG>
var.desc: Specify a CMake file that overrides platform information for <LANG>.

var.name: CMAKE_USE_RELATIVE_PATHS
var.desc: This variable has no effect. The partially implemented effect it had in previous releases was removed in CMake 3.4.

var.name: CMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE
var.desc: Enable verbose output from Makefile builds.

var.name: CMAKE_VERIFY_INTERFACE_HEADER_SETS
var.desc: This variable is used to initialize the VERIFY_INTERFACE_HEADER_SETS property of targets when they are created. Setting it to true enables header set verification.

var.name: CMAKE_VERSION
var.desc: The CMake version string as three non-negative integer components separated by . and possibly followed by - and other information. The first two components represent the feature level and the third component represents either a bug-fix level or development date.

var.name: CMAKE_VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN
var.desc: Default value for the VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN target property when a target is created.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_DEBUGGER_COMMAND
var.desc: This variable is used to initialize the VS_DEBUGGER_COMMAND property on each target as it is created. See that target property for additional information.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_DEBUGGER_COMMAND_ARGUMENTS
var.desc: This variable is used to initialize the VS_DEBUGGER_COMMAND_ARGUMENTS property on each target as it is created. See that target property for additional information.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_DEBUGGER_ENVIRONMENT
var.desc: This variable is used to initialize the VS_DEBUGGER_ENVIRONMENT property on each target as it is created. See that target property for additional information.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_DEBUGGER_WORKING_DIRECTORY
var.desc: This variable is used to initialize the VS_DEBUGGER_WORKING_DIRECTORY property on each target as it is created. See that target property for additional information.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_DEVENV_COMMAND
var.desc: The Visual Studio Generators set this variable to the devenv.com command installed with the corresponding Visual Studio version.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_GLOBALS
var.desc: List of Key=Value records to be set per target as target properties VS_GLOBAL_<variable> with variable=Key and value Value.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_INCLUDE_INSTALL_TO_DEFAULT_BUILD
var.desc: Include INSTALL target to default build.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_INCLUDE_PACKAGE_TO_DEFAULT_BUILD
var.desc: Include PACKAGE target to default build.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_INTEL_Fortran_PROJECT_VERSION
var.desc: When generating for Visual Studio 14 2015 or greater with the Intel Fortran plugin installed, this specifies the .vfproj project file format version. This is intended for internal use by CMake and should not be used by project code.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_JUST_MY_CODE_DEBUGGING
var.desc: Enable Just My Code with Visual Studio debugger.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_MSBUILD_COMMAND
var.desc: The Visual Studio Generators set this variable to the MSBuild.exe command installed with the corresponding Visual Studio version.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_NO_COMPILE_BATCHING
var.desc: Turn off compile batching when using Visual Studio Generators.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_NUGET_PACKAGE_RESTORE
var.desc: When using Visual Studio Generators, this cache variable controls if msbuild should automatically attempt to restore NuGet packages prior to a build. NuGet packages can be defined using the VS_PACKAGE_REFERENCES property on a target. If no package references are defined, this setting will do nothing.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_NsightTegra_VERSION
var.desc: When using Visual Studio Generators with the CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME variable set to Android, this variable contains the version number of the installed NVIDIA Nsight Tegra Visual Studio Edition.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_PLATFORM_NAME
var.desc: Visual Studio target platform name used by the current generator.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_PLATFORM_NAME_DEFAULT
var.desc: Default for the Visual Studio target platform name for the current generator without considering the value of the CMAKE_GENERATOR_PLATFORM variable. For Visual Studio Generators for VS 2017 and below this is always Win32. For VS 2019 and above this is based on the host platform.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_PLATFORM_TOOLSET
var.desc: Visual Studio Platform Toolset name.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_PLATFORM_TOOLSET_CUDA
var.desc: NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit version whose Visual Studio toolset to use.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_PLATFORM_TOOLSET_CUDA_CUSTOM_DIR
var.desc: Path to standalone NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit (eg. extracted from installer).

var.name: CMAKE_VS_PLATFORM_TOOLSET_FORTRAN
var.desc: Fortran compiler to be used by Visual Studio projects.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_PLATFORM_TOOLSET_HOST_ARCHITECTURE
var.desc: Visual Studio preferred tool architecture.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_PLATFORM_TOOLSET_VERSION
var.desc: Visual Studio Platform Toolset version.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_SDK_EXCLUDE_DIRECTORIES
var.desc: This variable allows to override Visual Studio default Exclude Directories.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_SDK_EXECUTABLE_DIRECTORIES
var.desc: This variable allows to override Visual Studio default Executable Directories.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_SDK_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES
var.desc: This variable allows to override Visual Studio default Include Directories.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_SDK_LIBRARY_DIRECTORIES
var.desc: This variable allows to override Visual Studio default Library Directories.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_SDK_LIBRARY_WINRT_DIRECTORIES
var.desc: This variable allows to override Visual Studio default Library WinRT Directories.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_SDK_REFERENCE_DIRECTORIES
var.desc: This variable allows to override Visual Studio default Reference Directories.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_SDK_SOURCE_DIRECTORIES
var.desc: This variable allows to override Visual Studio default Source Directories.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_TARGET_FRAMEWORK_IDENTIFIER
var.desc: Visual Studio target framework identifier.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_TARGET_FRAMEWORK_TARGETS_VERSION
var.desc: Visual Studio target framework targets version.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_TARGET_FRAMEWORK_VERSION
var.desc: Visual Studio target framework version.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_USE_DEBUG_LIBRARIES
var.desc: Indicate to Visual Studio Generators what configurations are considered debug configurations. This controls the UseDebugLibraries setting in each configuration of a .vcxproj file.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_VERSION_BUILD_NUMBER
var.desc: Visual Studio version.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_WINDOWS_TARGET_PLATFORM_MIN_VERSION
var.desc: Tell Visual Studio Generators to use the given Windows Target Platform Minimum Version.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_WINDOWS_TARGET_PLATFORM_VERSION
var.desc: Visual Studio Windows Target Platform Version.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_WINDOWS_TARGET_PLATFORM_VERSION_MAXIMUM
var.desc: Override the Windows 10 SDK Maximum Version for VS 2015 and beyond.

var.name: CMAKE_VS_WINRT_BY_DEFAULT
var.desc: Inform Visual Studio Generators for VS 2010 and above that the target platform enables WinRT compilation by default and it needs to be explicitly disabled if /ZW or VS_WINRT_COMPONENT is omitted (as opposed to enabling it when either of those options is present)

var.name: CMAKE_WARN_DEPRECATED
var.desc: Whether to issue warnings for deprecated functionality.

var.name: CMAKE_WARN_ON_ABSOLUTE_INSTALL_DESTINATION
var.desc: Ask cmake_install.cmake script to warn each time a file with absolute INSTALL DESTINATION is encountered.

var.name: CMAKE_WATCOM_RUNTIME_LIBRARY
var.desc: Select the Watcom runtime library for use by compilers targeting the Watcom ABI. This variable is used to initialize the WATCOM_RUNTIME_LIBRARY property on all targets as they are created. It is also propagated by calls to the try_compile() command into the test project.

var.name: CMAKE_WIN32_EXECUTABLE
var.desc: Default value for WIN32_EXECUTABLE of targets.

var.name: CMAKE_WINDOWS_EXPORT_ALL_SYMBOLS
var.desc: Default value for WINDOWS_EXPORT_ALL_SYMBOLS target property. This variable is used to initialize the property on each target as it is created.

var.name: CMAKE_WINDOWS_KMDF_VERSION
var.desc: Specify the Kernel-Mode Drive Framework target version.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_<an-attribute>
var.desc: Set Xcode target attributes directly.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_BUILD_SYSTEM
var.desc: Xcode build system selection.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_GENERATE_SCHEME
var.desc: If enabled, the Xcode generator will generate schema files. These are useful to invoke analyze, archive, build-for-testing and test actions from the command line.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_GENERATE_TOP_LEVEL_PROJECT_ONLY
var.desc: If enabled, the Xcode generator will generate only a single Xcode project file for the topmost project() command instead of generating one for every project() command.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_LINK_BUILD_PHASE_MODE
var.desc: This variable is used to initialize the XCODE_LINK_BUILD_PHASE_MODE property on targets. It affects the methods that the Xcode generator uses to link different kinds of libraries. Its default value is NONE.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_PLATFORM_TOOLSET
var.desc: Xcode compiler selection.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_SCHEME_ADDRESS_SANITIZER
var.desc: Whether to enable Address Sanitizer in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_SCHEME_ADDRESS_SANITIZER_USE_AFTER_RETURN
var.desc: Whether to enable Detect use of stack after return in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_SCHEME_DEBUG_DOCUMENT_VERSIONING
var.desc: Whether to enable Allow debugging when using document Versions Browser in the Options section of the generated Xcode scheme.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_SCHEME_DISABLE_MAIN_THREAD_CHECKER
var.desc: Whether to disable the Main Thread Checker in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_SCHEME_DYNAMIC_LIBRARY_LOADS
var.desc: Whether to enable Dynamic Library Loads in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_SCHEME_DYNAMIC_LINKER_API_USAGE
var.desc: Whether to enable Dynamic Linker API usage in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_SCHEME_ENABLE_GPU_API_VALIDATION
var.desc: Populate Metal: API Validation in the Options section of the generated Xcode scheme.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_SCHEME_ENABLE_GPU_FRAME_CAPTURE_MODE
var.desc: Populate GPU Frame Capture in the Options section of the generated Xcode scheme. Example values are Metal and Disabled.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_SCHEME_ENABLE_GPU_SHADER_VALIDATION
var.desc: Populate Metal: Shader Validation in the Options section of the generated Xcode scheme.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_SCHEME_ENVIRONMENT
var.desc: Specify environment variables that should be added to the Arguments section of the generated Xcode scheme.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_SCHEME_GUARD_MALLOC
var.desc: Whether to enable Guard Malloc in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_SCHEME_LAUNCH_CONFIGURATION
var.desc: Set the build configuration to run the target.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_SCHEME_LAUNCH_MODE
var.desc: Populate Launch in the Info section of the generated Xcode scheme.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_SCHEME_LLDB_INIT_FILE
var.desc: Populate LLDB Init File in the Info section of the generated Xcode scheme.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_SCHEME_MAIN_THREAD_CHECKER_STOP
var.desc: Whether to enable the Main Thread Checker option Pause on issues in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_SCHEME_MALLOC_GUARD_EDGES
var.desc: Whether to enable Malloc Guard Edges in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_SCHEME_MALLOC_SCRIBBLE
var.desc: Whether to enable Malloc Scribble in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_SCHEME_MALLOC_STACK
var.desc: Whether to enable Malloc Stack in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_SCHEME_TEST_CONFIGURATION
var.desc: Set the build configuration for testing targets.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_SCHEME_THREAD_SANITIZER
var.desc: Whether to enable Thread Sanitizer in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_SCHEME_THREAD_SANITIZER_STOP
var.desc: Whether to enable Thread Sanitizer - Pause on issues in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_SCHEME_UNDEFINED_BEHAVIOUR_SANITIZER
var.desc: Whether to enable Undefined Behavior Sanitizer in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_SCHEME_UNDEFINED_BEHAVIOUR_SANITIZER_STOP
var.desc: Whether to enable Undefined Behavior Sanitizer option Pause on issues in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_SCHEME_WORKING_DIRECTORY
var.desc: Specify the Working Directory of the Run and Profile actions in the generated Xcode scheme.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_SCHEME_ZOMBIE_OBJECTS
var.desc: Whether to enable Zombie Objects in the Diagnostics section of the generated Xcode scheme.

var.name: CMAKE_XCODE_XCCONFIG
var.desc: If set, the Xcode generator will register the specified file as a global XCConfig file. For target-level XCConfig files see the XCODE_XCCONFIG target property.

var.name: CPACK_ABSOLUTE_DESTINATION_FILES
var.desc: List of files which have been installed using an ABSOLUTE DESTINATION path.

var.name: CPACK_COMPONENT_INCLUDE_TOPLEVEL_DIRECTORY
var.desc: Boolean toggle to include/exclude top level directory (component case).

var.name: CPACK_CUSTOM_INSTALL_VARIABLES
var.desc: CPack variables (set via e.g. cpack -D, CPackConfig.cmake or CPACK_PROJECT_CONFIG_FILE scripts) are not directly visible in installation scripts. Instead, one can pass a list of varName=value pairs in the CPACK_CUSTOM_INSTALL_VARIABLES variable. At install time, each list item will result in a variable of the specified name (varName) being set to the given value. The = can be omitted for an empty value.

var.name: CPACK_ERROR_ON_ABSOLUTE_INSTALL_DESTINATION
var.desc: Ask CPack to error out as soon as a file with absolute INSTALL DESTINATION is encountered.

var.name: CPACK_INCLUDE_TOPLEVEL_DIRECTORY
var.desc: Boolean toggle to include/exclude top level directory.

var.name: CPACK_INSTALL_DEFAULT_DIRECTORY_PERMISSIONS
var.desc: Default permissions for implicitly created directories during packaging.

var.name: CPACK_PACKAGING_INSTALL_PREFIX
var.desc: The prefix used in the built package.

var.name: CPACK_SET_DESTDIR
var.desc: Boolean toggle to make CPack use DESTDIR mechanism when packaging.

var.name: CPACK_WARN_ON_ABSOLUTE_INSTALL_DESTINATION
var.desc: Ask CPack to warn each time a file with absolute INSTALL DESTINATION is encountered.

var.name: CTEST_BINARY_DIRECTORY
var.desc: Specify the CTest BuildDirectory setting in a ctest(1) dashboard client script.

var.name: CTEST_BUILD_COMMAND
var.desc: Specify the CTest MakeCommand setting in a ctest(1) dashboard client script.

var.name: CTEST_BUILD_NAME
var.desc: Specify the CTest BuildName setting in a ctest(1) dashboard client script.

var.name: CTEST_BZR_COMMAND
var.desc: Specify the CTest BZRCommand setting in a ctest(1) dashboard client script.

var.name: CTEST_BZR_UPDATE_OPTIONS
var.desc: Specify the CTest BZRUpdateOptions setting in a ctest(1) dashboard client script.

var.name: CTEST_CHANGE_ID
var.desc: Specify the CTest ChangeId setting in a ctest(1) dashboard client script.

var.name: CTEST_CHECKOUT_COMMAND
var.desc: Tell the ctest_start() command how to checkout or initialize the source directory in a ctest(1) dashboard client script.

var.name: CTEST_CONFIGURATION_TYPE
var.desc: Specify the CTest DefaultCTestConfigurationType setting in a ctest(1) dashboard client script.

var.name: CTEST_CONFIGURE_COMMAND
var.desc: Specify the CTest ConfigureCommand setting in a ctest(1) dashboard client script.

var.name: CTEST_COVERAGE_COMMAND
var.desc: Specify the CTest CoverageCommand setting in a ctest(1) dashboard client script.

var.name: CTEST_COVERAGE_EXTRA_FLAGS
var.desc: Specify the CTest CoverageExtraFlags setting in a ctest(1) dashboard client script.

var.name: CTEST_CURL_OPTIONS
var.desc: Specify the CTest CurlOptions setting in a ctest(1) dashboard client script.

var.name: CTEST_CUSTOM_COVERAGE_EXCLUDE
var.desc: A list of regular expressions which will be used to exclude files by their path from coverage output by the ctest_coverage() command.

var.name: CTEST_CUSTOM_ERROR_EXCEPTION
var.desc: A list of regular expressions which will be used to exclude when detecting error messages in build outputs by the ctest_build() command.

var.name: CTEST_CUSTOM_ERROR_MATCH
var.desc: A list of regular expressions which will be used to detect error messages in build outputs by the ctest_build() command.

var.name: CTEST_CUSTOM_ERROR_POST_CONTEXT
var.desc: The number of lines to include as context which follow an error message by the ctest_build() command. The default is 10.

var.name: CTEST_CUSTOM_ERROR_PRE_CONTEXT
var.desc: The number of lines to include as context which precede an error message by the ctest_build() command. The default is 10.

var.name: CTEST_CUSTOM_MAXIMUM_FAILED_TEST_OUTPUT_SIZE
var.desc: When saving a failing test's output, this is the maximum size, in bytes, that will be collected by the ctest_test() command. Defaults to 307200 (300 KiB). See CTEST_CUSTOM_TEST_OUTPUT_TRUNCATION for possible truncation modes.

var.name: CTEST_CUSTOM_MAXIMUM_NUMBER_OF_ERRORS
var.desc: The maximum number of errors in a single build step which will be detected. After this, the ctest_test() command will truncate the output. Defaults to 50.

var.name: CTEST_CUSTOM_MAXIMUM_NUMBER_OF_WARNINGS
var.desc: The maximum number of warnings in a single build step which will be detected. After this, the ctest_test() command will truncate the output. Defaults to 50.

var.name: CTEST_CUSTOM_MAXIMUM_PASSED_TEST_OUTPUT_SIZE
var.desc: When saving a passing test's output, this is the maximum size, in bytes, that will be collected by the ctest_test() command. Defaults to 1024 (1 KiB). See CTEST_CUSTOM_TEST_OUTPUT_TRUNCATION for possible truncation modes.

var.name: CTEST_CUSTOM_MEMCHECK_IGNORE
var.desc: A list of regular expressions to use to exclude tests during the ctest_memcheck() command.

var.name: CTEST_CUSTOM_POST_MEMCHECK
var.desc: A list of commands to run at the end of the ctest_memcheck() command.

var.name: CTEST_CUSTOM_POST_TEST
var.desc: A list of commands to run at the end of the ctest_test() command.

var.name: CTEST_CUSTOM_PRE_MEMCHECK
var.desc: A list of commands to run at the start of the ctest_memcheck() command.

var.name: CTEST_CUSTOM_PRE_TEST
var.desc: A list of commands to run at the start of the ctest_test() command.

var.name: CTEST_CUSTOM_TESTS_IGNORE
var.desc: A list of test names to be excluded from the set of tests run by the ctest_test() command.

var.name: CTEST_CUSTOM_TEST_OUTPUT_TRUNCATION
var.desc: Set the test output truncation mode in case a maximum size is configured via the CTEST_CUSTOM_MAXIMUM_PASSED_TEST_OUTPUT_SIZE or CTEST_CUSTOM_MAXIMUM_FAILED_TEST_OUTPUT_SIZE variables. By default the tail of the output will be truncated. Other possible values are middle and head.

var.name: CTEST_CUSTOM_WARNING_EXCEPTION
var.desc: A list of regular expressions which will be used to exclude when detecting warning messages in build outputs by the ctest_build() command.

var.name: CTEST_CUSTOM_WARNING_MATCH
var.desc: A list of regular expressions which will be used to detect warning messages in build outputs by the ctest_build() command.

var.name: CTEST_MEMORYCHECK_SUPPRESSIONS_FILE

var.name: MSVC90
var.desc: Discouraged. Use the MSVC_VERSION variable instead.

var.name: MSVC_IDE
var.desc: True when using the Microsoft Visual C++ IDE.

var.name: MSVC_TOOLSET_VERSION
var.desc: The toolset version of Microsoft Visual C/C++ being used if any. If MSVC-like is being used, this variable is set based on the version of the compiler as given by the MSVC_VERSION variable.

var.name: MSVC_VERSION
var.desc: The version of Microsoft Visual C/C++ being used if any. If a compiler simulating Visual C++ is being used, this variable is set to the toolset version simulated as given by the _MSC_VER preprocessor definition.

var.name: MSYS
var.desc: True when using the MSYS Makefiles generator.

var.name: PROJECT_BINARY_DIR
var.desc: Full path to build directory for project.

var.name: PROJECT_COMPAT_VERSION
var.desc: Value given to the COMPAT_VERSION option of the most recent call to the project() command, if any. To obtain the compatibility version of the top level project, see the CMAKE_PROJECT_COMPAT_VERSION variable.

var.name: PROJECT_DESCRIPTION
var.desc: Short project description given to the project command.

var.name: PROJECT_HOMEPAGE_URL
var.desc: The homepage URL of the project.

var.name: PROJECT_IS_TOP_LEVEL
var.desc: A boolean variable indicating whether the most recently called project() command in the current scope or above was in the top level CMakeLists.txt file.

var.name: PROJECT_NAME
var.desc: Name of the project given to the project command.

var.name: PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR
var.desc: This is the source directory of the last call to the project() command made in the current directory scope or one of its parents. Note, it is not affected by calls to project() made within a child directory scope (i.e. from within a call to add_subdirectory() from the current scope).

var.name: PROJECT_SPDX_LICENSE
var.desc: Value given to the SPDX_LICENSE option of the most recent call to the project() command, if any. To obtain the compatibility version of the top level project, see the CMAKE_PROJECT_SPDX_LICENSE variable.

var.name: PROJECT_VERSION
var.desc: Value given to the VERSION option of the most recent call to the project() command, if any.

var.name: PROJECT_VERSION_MAJOR
var.desc: First version number component of the PROJECT_VERSION variable as set by the project() command.

var.name: PROJECT_VERSION_MINOR
var.desc: Second version number component of the PROJECT_VERSION variable as set by the project() command.

var.name: PROJECT_VERSION_PATCH
var.desc: Third version number component of the PROJECT_VERSION variable as set by the project() command.

var.name: PROJECT_VERSION_TWEAK
var.desc: Fourth version number component of the PROJECT_VERSION variable as set by the project() command.

var.name: UNIX
var.desc: Set to True when the target system is UNIX or UNIX-like (e.g. APPLE and CYGWIN). The CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME variable should be queried if a more specific understanding of the target system is required.

var.name: WASI
var.desc: Set to 1 when the target system is WebAssembly System Interface (CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME is WASI).

var.name: WIN32
var.desc: Set to True when the target system is Windows, including Win64.

var.name: WINCE
var.desc: True when the CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME variable is set to WindowsCE.

var.name: WINDOWS_PHONE
var.desc: True when the CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME variable is set to WindowsPhone.

var.name: WINDOWS_STORE
var.desc: True when the CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME variable is set to WindowsStore.

var.name: XCODE
var.desc: True when using Xcode generator.

var.name: XCODE_VERSION
var.desc: Version of Xcode (Xcode generator only).
